habit.definition:
n. an established custom
n. (psychology) an automatic pattern of behavior in reaction to a specific situation; may be inherited or acquired through frequent repetition
n. a distinctive attire worn by a member of a religious order
n. the general form or mode of growth (especially of a plant or crystal)
habit.translation: n. 习惯, 嗜好, 习性\nvt. 使穿衣

examples.en: He has a habit of looking down on coloured people.
examples.zh: 他有瞧不起有色人种的习惯。

examples.en: I wish I could break the habit of smoking.
examples.zh: 真希望自己能把烟瘾戒掉。

examples.en: She is in the habit of keeping late hours.
examples.zh: 她习惯熬夜。

habitat.definition: n. the type of environment in which an organism or group normally lives or occurs
habitat.translation: n. 栖息地, 居留地, 自生地, 聚集处\n[医] 习生地, 产地, 生境, 栖所

examples.en: Wetlands play important roles in the ecosystem in purifying water, protecting against flood and erosion, and as both a source of food and habitat for wild animals.
examples.zh: 湿地在生态系统中扮演着净化水源、防止洪水和侵蚀、为野生动物提供食物和栖息地的重要角色。

hack.definition:
n. one who works hard at boring tasks
n. a mediocre and disdained writer
n. a tool (as a hoe or pick or mattock) used for breaking up the surface of the soil
n. an old or over-worked horse
hack.translation:
n. 劈, 砍, 砍痕, 出租车, 干咳, 晒架, 鹤嘴锄
vt. 劈, 砍, 出租, 用旧
vi. 劈, 砍, 干咳, 驾驶出租车
a. 出租的

examples.en: We hacked a path through the forest.
examples.zh: 我们开出了一条穿过森林的小路。

examples.en: I'm sure it wouldn't be too hard to find out who hacked into our system.
examples.zh: 要找出入侵我们系统的黑客，我相信不会太难。

hail.definition:
n. precipitation of ice pellets when there are strong rising air currents
n. many objects thrown forcefully through the air
n. enthusiastic greeting
v. be a native of
hail.translation:
n. 冰雹, 致敬, 欢呼, 招呼
vt. 向...欢呼, 致敬, 招呼, 使象下雹样落下
vi. 招呼, 下雹
interj. 万岁, 欢迎

examples.en: There's no need to hail a taxi.
examples.zh: 没必要叫出租车。

examples.en: We marched under a hail of bullets.
examples.zh: 我们在枪林弹雨之下行进。

examples.en: Have you ever seen it hail?
examples.zh: 你什么时候看见过冰雹吗？

hair.definition:
n. a covering for the body (or parts of it) consisting of a dense growth of threadlike structures (as on the human head); helps to prevent heat loss
n. filamentous hairlike growth on a plant
n. any of the cylindrical filaments characteristically growing from the epidermis of a mammal
n. a filamentous projection or process on an organism
hair.translation: n. 头发, 毛发, 些微\n[医] 毛, 发

examples.en: I had my hair cut at the barber shop yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天去了理发店理发。

examples.en: It's become a hassle to keep on dyeing my hair.
examples.zh: 一直染发太麻烦了。

examples.en: Have you noticed any changes in your hair or nails?
examples.zh: 您有注意到您的头髪或者指甲有什么变化吗？

half.definition:
n. one of two divisions into which some games or performances are divided: the two divisions are separated by an interval
s. consisting of one of two equivalent parts in value or quantity
s. partial
a. (of siblings) related through one parent only
half.translation: n. 一半, 半场, 不完全\na. 一半的, 不完全的, 部分的, 半场的\nadv. 一半地, 部分地, 在某种程度上地, 几乎

examples.en: Life is half spent before we know what it is.
examples.zh: 在我们了解人生之前人生已经过了一半。

examples.en: Tom only earns half as much money as Mary does.
examples.zh: 汤姆赚的钱只有玛丽的一半。

examples.en: You should have started an hour and a half ago.
examples.zh: 你一个半小时以前就应该开始了。

hall.definition:
n. a large room for gatherings or entertainment
n. English writer whose novel about a lesbian relationship was banned in Britain for many years (1883-1943)
n. United States child psychologist whose theories of child psychology strongly influenced educational psychology (1844-1924)
n. United States chemist who developed an economical method of producing aluminum from bauxite (1863-1914)
hall.translation: n. 门厅, 走廊, 会堂

examples.en: The number of the chairs in the hall is 80.
examples.zh: 大厅里有八十张椅子。

examples.en: I passed the city hall on my way to the station.
examples.zh: 我去车站的路上路过了市政厅。

examples.en: It's too bad the college dining hall doesn't have fig cookies.
examples.zh: 可惜大学食堂没有无花果饼干。

halt.translation:
n. 停止, 立定, 休息
vt. 使停止, 使立定
vi. 立定, 停止, 蹒跚, 踌躇, 有缺点
[计] 停止

examples.en: As the train came to a halt, all of the passengers wondered what was happening.
examples.zh: 当列车停止时，所有的乘客都想知道发生了什么。

hammer.definition:
n. the part of a gunlock that strikes the percussion cap when the trigger is pulled
n. a hand tool with a heavy rigid head and a handle; used to deliver an impulsive force by striking
n. a heavy metal sphere attached to a flexible wire; used in the hammer throw
n. a striker that is covered in felt and that causes the piano strings to vibrate
hammer.translation:
n. 锤, 铁锤, 钉锤
vt. 锤打, 敲打, 钉
vi. 连续锤打
[计] 锤头

examples.en: Could you get a hammer for me from the kitchen please?
examples.zh: 你到厨房里替我把一把锤子拿来。

examples.en: Tom took the hammer away from Mary.
examples.zh: 汤姆从玛丽那里拿走了锤子。

examples.en: The hammer and sickle stand for communism.
examples.zh: 锤子与镰刀代表共产主义。

hamper.definition: n. a basket usually with a cover\nv. prevent the progress or free movement of
hamper.translation: n. 食篮, 阻碍物, 食盒\nvt. 阻碍, 使困累, 妨碍, 牵制

examples.en: Large patches of fog continued to hamper visibility for motorists.
Put your dirty laundry in the hamper, not on the floor.
Keep dirty clothes in the laundry hamper, not on the floor.

hand.definition:
n. the (prehensile) extremity of the superior limb
n. ability
n. a position given by its location to the side of an object
n. the cards held in a card game by a given player at any given time
hand.translation: n. 手, 爪, 指针, 掌握, 协助, 人手, 手艺, 手迹, 支配, 插手\nvt. 交给, 支持, 搀扶

examples.en: I know New York like the back of my hand.
examples.zh: 我对纽约了如指掌。

examples.en: My hand is so cold I can't feel it anymore.
examples.zh: 我的手冷到没有感觉了。

examples.en: What I have in my hand is a fossil seashell.
examples.zh: 在我手里的是一个贝壳化石。

handbook.definition: n. a concise reference book providing specific information about a subject or location

examples.en: The school handbook lists impermissible forms of protest on campus.
Tom spent the afternoon reading a survival handbook.
This new gardening handbook could be a useful resource for plant lovers.

handful.definition: n. a small number or amount\nn. the quantity that can be held in the hand
handful.translation: n. 少数, 一把, 棘手事

examples.en: Tom bent down and picked up a handful of sand.
examples.zh: 汤姆弯下腰，捧起了一把沙子。

examples.en: Only a handful of people know the fact.
examples.zh: 知道真相的人只有几个。

examples.en: He grabbed a handful of rice.
examples.zh: 他抓了一把米。

handicap.definition: n. advantage given to a competitor to equalize chances of winning\nv. attempt to forecast the winner (especially in a horse race) and assign odds for or against a contestant\nv. put at a disadvantage
handicap.translation: n. 障碍, 困难, 不利条件\nvt. 加障碍于, 妨碍

examples.en: Having no will is the worst handicap.
examples.zh: 没有愿望是最大的障碍。

handicraft.definition: n. a work produced by hand labor\nn. a craft that requires skillful hands
handicraft.translation: n. 手工艺, 手艺\n[经] 手工业, 手工

examples.en: Her handicraft is more than a hobby. It's more like a profession.
Manufacturing activities are limited to fruit processing, clothing, and handicrafts.
I took a handicraft course last year.

handkerchief.definition: n. a square piece of cloth used for wiping the eyes or nose or as a costume accessory
handkerchief.translation: n. 手帕, 头巾, 围巾

examples.en: He wiped his hands on a handkerchief.
examples.zh: 他用手帕把手抹干净。

examples.en: She is always losing her handkerchief.
examples.zh: 她老是弄丢她的手帕。

examples.en: How much is this handkerchief?
examples.zh: 请问这个手帕多少钱？

handle.definition: n. the appendage to an object that is designed to be held in order to use or move it\nv. touch, lift, or hold with the hands\nv. show and train
handle.translation:
n. 柄, 把手, 把柄, 柄状物, 手感
vt. 触摸, 运用, 买卖, 处理, 操作
vi. 搬运, 易于操纵
n. 句柄
[计] 句柄

examples.en: We handle all type of books, both new and old.
examples.zh: 我们处理各种书籍，包括新的和旧的。

examples.en: It is difficult for me to handle the case.
examples.zh: 我处理这事有困难。

examples.en: I’m still thinking how I’m going to handle this.
examples.zh: 我还在想我如何处理这件事。

handsome.definition: s pleasing in appearance especially by reason of conformity to ideals of form and proportion\ns given or giving freely
handsome.translation: a. 英俊的, 大方的, 慷慨的, 相当可观的, 美观的, 灵敏的

examples.en: Tom wasn't as handsome as Mary said he was.
examples.zh: 汤姆并不是玛丽说得那样英俊。

examples.en: My father must have been handsome in his youth.
examples.zh: 我爸爸年轻的时候一定很英俊。

examples.en: He is young and, what is more, handsome.
examples.zh: 他很年轻，更重要的是，他很帅。

handy.definition:
n. United States blues musician who transcribed and published traditional blues music (1873-1958)
s. easy to reach
s. easy to use
s. skillful with the hands
handy.translation: a. 便利的, 敏捷的, 容易取得的\n[化] 便于使用的; 易操作的

examples.en: I'll keep this information handy for future reference.
examples.zh: 我会将这则资讯记下来，以便未来参考。

examples.en: She is handy with a needle.
examples.zh: 她擅长针线活。

examples.en: It really comes in handy.
examples.zh: 这真的能派上用场。

hang.definition:
n. the way a garment hangs
n. a gymnastic exercise performed on the rings or horizontal bar or parallel bars when the gymnast's weight is supported by the arms
v. be suspended or hanging
v. cause to be hanging or suspended
hang.translation: n. 悬挂, 诀窍, 意义\nvt. 悬挂, 附着, 装饰, 垂下, 踌躇, 绞死, 使悬而未决\nvi. 悬着, 垂下, 被绞死, 悬而不决

examples.en: Tom wants us to hang the TV on the wall.
examples.zh: Tom想把电视挂在墙上。

examples.en: Olympus? Isn't that where Greek gods hang out or something?
examples.zh: 奥林匹斯山？那不是希腊众神鬼混的地方？

examples.en: Hang on, I need to go to the bathroom.
examples.zh: 等一下，我得去趟洗手间。

happen.definition:
v. come to pass
v. happen, occur, or be the case in the course of events or by chance
v. chance to be or do something, without intention or causation
v. come into being; become reality
happen.translation: vi. 发生, 发生, 恰巧

examples.en: There is no telling what will happen in the future.
examples.zh: 谁也不知道将来会发生甚么事。

examples.en: I don't even want to think about what could happen.
examples.zh: 我甚至不想去想会发生什么。

examples.en: Tom said that he thought that would probably never happen.
examples.zh: 汤姆说他觉得那可能永远不会发生了。

happiness.definition: n. state of well-being characterized by emotions ranging from contentment to intense joy\nn. emotions experienced when in a state of well-being
happiness.translation: n. 快乐, 幸运, 适当

examples.en: To love and to be loved is the greatest happiness.
examples.zh: 爱和被爱是人生最大的乐事。

examples.en: But I'm not sure whether it brings happiness to everybody.
examples.zh: 但我不确定它会把幸福带给每个人。

examples.en: Education is the path to happiness, peace, righteousness, and success.
examples.zh: 教育是通往幸福、和平、正义与成功的道路。

happy.definition: a. enjoying or showing or marked by joy or pleasure\ns. well expressed and to the point
happy.translation: a. 快乐的, 幸福的, 愉快的, 恰当的

examples.en: He is poor, to be sure, but he is happy.
examples.zh: 他确实很穷，但是他很幸福。

examples.en: I am not too rich, too fat or too happy.
examples.zh: 我不太有钱、不太胖，也不太快乐。

examples.en: For all the money he has, he is not happy.
examples.zh: 尽管他有那么多钱，他并不快乐。

harass.definition: v. annoy continually or chronically\nv. exhaust by attacking repeatedly
harass.translation: vt. 使困扰, 使烦恼, 折磨

examples.en: The mayor's family was harassed with threatening phone calls all day.
examples.zh: 市长一家人一整天不断遭到了恐吓电话的骚扰。

examples.en: Tell your son to quit harassing my daughter.
examples.zh: 让你的儿子别来骚扰我的女儿。

harbor.definition: n. a place of refuge and comfort and security\nv. maintain (a theory, thoughts, or feelings)\nv. secretly shelter (as of fugitives or criminals)
harbor.translation: n. 港, 避难所\nv. 庇护, 藏匿, (使)入港停泊

examples.en: We saw many ships in the harbor.
examples.zh: 我们在港口里看到了许多船。

examples.en: There are many ships in the harbor.
examples.zh: 港口内有许多船。

examples.en: The boat was piloted safely into harbor.
examples.zh: 船被安全地领入港口。

hard.definition:
a. dispassionate; 
a. resisting weight or pressure
s. very strong or vigorous
a. (of light) transmitted directly from a pointed light source
hard.translation: a. 坚硬的, 硬的, 难的, 艰苦的, 困难的, 坚固的, 猛烈的, 艰难的, 结实的, 确实的\nadv. 坚硬地, 努力地, 辛苦地, 接近地, 猛烈地, 牢固地

examples.en: You work as hard as he did at your age.
examples.zh: 你跟他在你这个年纪时一样努力工作。

examples.en: He left me with tons of hard work to do.
examples.zh: 他把那么难做的活儿丢给我。

examples.en: Nancy is a hard girl for me to deal with.
examples.zh: 对我来说，Nancy是个很难相处的女孩。

harden.definition: v. become hard or harder\nv. make hard or harder
harden.translation: vt. 使变硬, 使坚强, 使冷酷\nvi. 变硬, 变冷酷

examples.en: Yanni's tattoos would put a hardened gang member to shame.
Don't touch my spaghetti bridge! The glue is still hardening.
Brother men who live after us, Harden not your hearts against us.

hardly.translation: adv. 刚刚, 几乎不, 勉强是

examples.en: Hardly had we come home when it began to rain.
examples.zh: 我们才一到家就下起雨来了。

examples.en: I could hardly follow what Jane said in her speech.
examples.zh: 我几乎完全跟不上 Jane 的演讲内容。

examples.en: I had hardly left home when it began to rain heavily.
examples.zh: 当雨开始下得很大的时候, 我几乎不能出门了。

hardship.definition: n. something that causes or entails suffering
hardship.translation: n. 艰难, 辛苦, 苦难\n[法] 受苦, 吃苦, 苦难

examples.en: The people's hardships are our hardships.
examples.zh: 人民的困难就是我们的困难。

examples.en: He overcame all sorts of hardship and setbacks to succeed in a solo crossing of Antarctica.
examples.zh: 他克服了种种困难和挫折，终于成功一个人越过了南极洲。

examples.en: Mountaineering is attractive especially to young people because it is accompanied with hardships and adventures.
examples.zh: 攀山是种既紧张刺激，又具挑战性的运动，因此特别受年青人欢迎。

hardware.definition: n. major items of military weaponry (as tanks or missile)\nn. instrumentalities (tools or implements) made of metal\nn. (computer science) the mechanical, magnetic, electronic, and electrical components making up a computer system
hardware.translation: n. 硬件, 五金器具, 零件\n[计] 硬件

examples.en: The transition from hardware to software happened gradually.
examples.zh: 由硬体到软体的转变是缓慢的。

examples.en: A user should have freedom with respect to both hardware and software. An operating system should be open, not closed.
examples.zh: 用户应该拥有硬件和软件的使用自由，操作系统应该是开放的，而不是封闭的。

harm.definition: v. cause or do harm to
harm.translation: n. 伤害, 害处\nvt. 伤害, 损害

examples.en: This kind of magazine can do harm to young people.
examples.zh: 这种杂志对年轻人有害。

examples.en: From my point of view, cars do more harm than good.
examples.zh: 在我看来，汽车是弊大于利。

examples.en: Don't worry about my dog. He won't do you any harm.
examples.zh: 不要担心我的狗，它不会伤害你。

harmful.definition: a. causing or capable of causing harm
harmful.translation: a. 有害的, 伤害的

examples.en: Playing games all night is very harmful to your health.
examples.zh: 通宵玩游戏很伤身体的。

examples.en: Fear is more harmful than the sharpest of swords.
examples.zh: 恐惧比利剑更伤人。

examples.en: Some medicines can be harmful to the body.
examples.zh: 有些药品会对身体产生危害。

harmless.definition: a. not causing or capable of causing harm
harmless.translation: a. 无害处的, 未受损害的, 无辜的, 无恶意的\n[法] 无害的, 无恶意的, 无损害的

examples.en: Liberty consists of being able to make everything as harmless as possible.
examples.zh: 自由旨在能够做所有不伤害其他人的事。

harmonious.definition:
a. musically pleasing
s. exhibiting equivalence or correspondence among constituents of an entity or between different entities
s. suitable and fitting
s. existing together in harmony
harmonious.translation: a. 和睦的, 调和的, 和谐的, 协调的

examples.en: Our sex life is not completely harmonious.
examples.zh: 我们的性生活不是十分和谐。

harmony.definition:
n. compatibility in opinion and action
n. the structure of music with respect to the composition and progression of chords
n. a harmonious state of things in general and of their properties (as of colors and sounds); congruity of parts with one another and with the whole
n. agreement of opinions
harmony.translation: n. 协调, 和睦, 调和\n[电] 和声学

examples.en: We must learn to live in harmony with nature.
examples.zh: 我们必须学会与自然和谐共处。

examples.en: Harmony in the family leads to success in everything.
examples.zh: 家和万事兴。

examples.en: Together, you represent the harmony between tradition and progress.
examples.zh: 你们共同代表著传统与进步之间的和谐。

harness.definition:
n. a support consisting of an arrangement of straps for holding something to the body (especially one supporting a person suspended from a parachute)
n. stable gear consisting of an arrangement of leather straps fitted to a draft animal so that it can be attached to and pull a cart
v. put a harness
v. exploit the power of
harness.translation: n. 马具, 挽具状带子, 甲胄\nvt. 给...上挽具, 驾驭, 披上甲胄, 利用...以产生动力

examples.en: There's new energy to harness, new jobs to be created, new schools to build, and threats to meet, alliances to repair.
examples.zh: 我们需要开发新的能源、创造新的工作岗位，我们需要修建新学校，应对众多威胁、修复与许多国家的盟友关系。

harsh.definition:
s. unpleasantly stern
s. disagreeable to the senses
s. unkind or cruel or uncivil
s. severe
harsh.translation: a. 粗糙的, 刺耳的, 严厉的\n[法] 粗糙的, 严厉的, 苛刻的

examples.en: I am slowly adjusting to the harsh climate here.
examples.zh: 我在慢慢习惯这苛刻的气候。

examples.en: He doesn't even dare to reply to a harsh word. He's such a coward.
examples.zh: 他连一句重话都不敢回，真是个窝囊废。

harvest.definition:
n. the consequence of an effort or activity
n. the gathering of a ripened crop
n. the season for gathering crops
v. remove from a culture or a living or dead body, as for the purposes of transplantation
harvest.translation: n. 收获, 成果, 收获物, 收获期\nv. 收割, 收获

examples.en: There has been a good apple harvest this year.
examples.zh: 今年苹果的收成不错。

examples.en: There was a large harvest of peaches last year.
examples.zh: 去年桃子丰收。

examples.en: A festival is held at the rice harvest.
examples.zh: 收获稻子时举办节日。

haste.definition: n. overly eager speed (and possible carelessness)\nn. the act of moving hurriedly and in a careless manner

examples.en: The report was prepared in haste and had several misspellings.
examples.zh: 报告是匆匆准备好的，所以含有个把错别字。

examples.en: Having been written in haste, the book has a lot of errors.
examples.zh: 这本书是匆匆忙忙地写的，所以有很多谬误。

examples.en: Being written in great haste, this letter has quite a few mistakes.
examples.zh: 这封信是十分匆匆忙忙地写的，所以有不少笔误。

hasty.definition: s. excessively quick\ns. done with very great haste and without due deliberation
hasty.translation: a. 匆匆的, 轻率的, 性怠的

examples.en: I ate a hasty lunch.
examples.zh: 我匆忙的吃了午餐。

examples.en: Don't do anything hasty.
examples.zh: 不要慌张喔。

hat.definition:
n. headdress that protects the head from bad weather; has shaped crown and usually a brim
n. an informal term for a person's role
v. put on or wear a hat
v. furnish with a hat
hat.translation: n. 帽子\nvt. 给...戴帽子

examples.en: If he can do that, I will eat my hat.
examples.zh: 他要是成了，我跟你姓。

examples.en: It took her a long time to choose a hat.
examples.zh: 她花了好长时间挑帽子。

examples.en: There were a hat and a coat on the wall.
examples.zh: 墙上挂着一顶帽子和一件大衣。

hatch.definition:
n. the production of young from an egg
n. shading consisting of multiple crossing lines
n. a movable barrier covering a hatchway
v. emerge from the eggs
hatch.translation: n. 孵化, 舱口\nvt. 孵, 孵出, 策划\nvi. 孵化

examples.en: A chicken hatches an egg and a chick emerges.
examples.zh: 母鸡孵蛋，孵出小鸡。

hate.definition: n. the emotion of intense dislike; a feeling of dislike so strong that it demands action\nv. dislike intensely; feel antipathy or aversion towards
hate.translation: n. 憎恨, 恨, 厌恶\nvt. 憎恨, 憎恶\nvi. 仇恨

examples.en: I don't like him much, in fact I hate him.
examples.zh: 我不太喜欢他，其实我讨厌他。

examples.en: I used to hate cooking, but now I like it.
examples.zh: 以前我是讨厌做菜，可现在我很喜欢。

examples.en: I hate women who say that all men are alike.
examples.zh: 我讨厌那些说男人都是一个样的女人。

hatred.definition: n the emotion of intense dislike; a feeling of dislike so strong that it demands action
hatred.translation: n. 憎恨, 仇恨, 憎恶\n[法] 敌意, 憎恨, 憎恶

examples.en: The look on his face was next door to hatred.
That's why I have such an extreme hatred for him.
The media sells a trace of hatred at bargain prices.

haul.definition: v. draw slowly or heavily\nv. transport in a vehicle
haul.translation: n. 用力拖拉, 拖运, 强拉, 捕获量, 拖运距离\nvi. 拖, 拉, 改变方向, 改变主意\nvt. 拖拉, 拖运

examples.en: Tom and Mary are in it for the long haul.
Tom and Mary are in this for the long haul.
The thieves made off with quite a haul.

haunt.definition: n. a frequently visited place\nv. follow stealthily or recur constantly and spontaneously to\nv. haunt like a ghost; pursue
haunt.translation: n. 常到的地方, 生息地\nvt. 常到, 出没于, 萦绕于\nvi. 出没, 作祟

examples.en: "The castle is haunted," he said with a shiver.
examples.zh: 他边颤抖边说：「那座城堡有鬼。」

examples.en: The mansion was so cheap because it was known to be haunted.
examples.zh: 那别墅因为听说闹鬼所以很便宜。

examples.en: It is said the house is haunted.
examples.zh: 据说这房子是个鬼屋。

have.definition:
v. have or possess, either in a concrete or an abstract sense
v. have as a feature
v. have a personal or business relationship with someone
v. have left
have.translation: vt. 有, 怀有, 拿, 进行\naux. 已经

examples.en: I am a cat. I don't have a name yet.
examples.zh: 我是一只猫。我还没有名字。

examples.en: I have no idea of how to send a fax.
examples.zh: 我不知道如何传真。

examples.en: We have a cat. We are all fond of it.
examples.zh: 我们有一只猫。我们都喜欢猫。

haven.definition: n. a shelter serving as a place of safety or sanctuary
haven.translation: n. 港, 避难所, 安息所\nvt. 安置...于港中, 庇护, 入港

examples.en: Damn, VS Code crashed and I haven’t saved the file yet.
examples.zh: 操，VS Code崩溃了，我还没保存文件。

hazard.definition: n. a source of danger; a possibility of incurring loss or misfortune\nn. an obstacle on a golf course
hazard.translation: n. 冒险, 危险, 机会\nvt. 冒...的危险, 赌运气, 使冒危险\n[计] 相关危险; 冒险

examples.en: A pot belly is an occupational hazard for office workers.
Ziri noticed a vehicle with its hazard lights on.
Be cautious near the well, it's a potential hazard.

hazardous.translation: a. 危险的, 冒险的, 碰运气的\n[法] 危险的, 冒险的, 碰运气的

examples.en: The road was too hazardous to travel in the snow.
Gusty winds are making travel hazardous for high profile vehicles.
The growing number of potholes is making cycling increasingly hazardous.

head.definition:
n. the upper part of the human body or the front part of the body in animals; contains the face and brains
n. a single domestic animal
n. a person who is in charge
n. the front of a military formation or procession
head.translation:
n. 头, 头脑, 领袖, 脑袋, 最前的部分
vt. 为首, 朝向, 前进, 用头顶
vi. 朝特定方向行进, (作物)结穗
a. 头的, 在顶端的, 主要的
[计] 磁头; 冲头

examples.en: Tom is at least one head taller than I am.
examples.zh: 汤姆起码比我高一个头。

examples.en: Tom bumped his head on the roof of the car.
examples.zh: 汤姆把头撞到车顶了。

examples.en: It's getting to be time for me to head back.
examples.zh: 差不多该回去了。

heading.definition: n. a line of text serving to indicate what the passage below it is about
heading.translation: n. 标题, 起始字, 方向\n[计] 上标题

examples.en: Where are you heading?
examples.zh: 您要去哪儿？

examples.en: We're heading back. We'll make sure to take care of what you asked us to do.
examples.zh: 我们要回去啦，你托我们的事情一定留心着。

examples.en: Most of the traffic coming into this seaside town is heading for the beachside holiday camp.
examples.zh: 进入这座海滨小镇的车辆大多是前往海边度假营地的。

headline.definition: n. the heading or caption of a newspaper article\nv. publicize widely or highly, as if with a headline\nv. provide (a newspaper page or a story) with a headline
headline.translation: n. 大标题, 新闻摘要\nvt. 为...做标题, 写标题

examples.en: The headline caught my eye this morning.
examples.zh: 大标题今天早上吸引了我的注意。

headquarters.definition: n. (usually plural) the office that serves as the administrative center of an enterprise\nn. the military installation from which a commander performs the functions of command\nn. (plural) a military unit consisting of a commander and the headquarters staff
headquarters.translation: n. 总部, 司令部, 总部人员\n[经] 本部, 总部, 总署

examples.en: There was a different kind of atmosphere in the headquarters.
examples.zh: 总部里有另外一种气氛。

heal.translation: vi. 痊愈\nvt. 使复原, 使和解, 治愈

examples.en: The cut is no longer weeping and is starting to heal.
examples.zh: 伤口已不流脓, 渐渐愈合了

examples.en: Daniel started spending more time with Amanda to help her heal.
examples.zh: 丹尼尔开始花更多时间陪伴阿曼达，从而帮助她康复。

examples.en: Wounds heal as time passes.
examples.zh: 时间会治愈一切伤痛。

health.definition: n. a healthy state of wellbeing free from disease\nn. the general condition of body and mind
health.translation: n. 健康, 卫生, 蓬勃, 健康状态\n[医] 健康

examples.en: I gave up smoking for the sake of my health.
examples.zh: 为健康戒了烟。

examples.en: A new health clinic is set to open next month.
examples.zh: 一家新的健康诊所将于下个月开幕。

examples.en: I don't care for smoking; it's bad for the health.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢吸烟，因为吸烟对身体不好。

healthy.definition:
a. having or indicating good health in body or mind; free from infirmity or disease
s. financially secure and functioning well
s. promoting health; healthful
s. exercising or showing good judgment
healthy.translation: a. 健康的, 有益健康的, 卫生的\n[医] 健康的

examples.en: I'm not as healthy as I used to be.
examples.zh: 我已经不像从前那样健康了。

examples.en: He runs every day so he is very healthy.
examples.zh: 他每天跑步，所以身体很好。

examples.en: Some of them are healthy, but others are not.
examples.zh: 他们中的一些人身体健康，但是其他人不是。

heap.definition: v. bestow in large quantities\nv. fill to overflow
heap.translation: n. 堆, 许多, 累积\nvt. 堆积, 装满\n[计] 堆

examples.en: Tom threw his clothes in a heap on the floor.
You do not have to pile everything in one heap.
The workers heap up the soil to create a barrier.

hear.definition: v. perceive (sound) via the auditory sense\nv. examine or hear (evidence or a case) by judicial process\nv. receive a communication from someone
hear.translation: vt. 听到, 倾听, 听说, 审理\nvi. 听见, 听

examples.en: I hear she is going to get married next month.
examples.zh: 我听说，她下个月结婚了。

examples.en: I didn't expect to hear back from Tom so soon.
examples.zh: 我没想到这么快就收到汤姆的回信。

examples.en: Whenever I hear this song, I think of his smile.
examples.zh: 只要听到这首歌，我就会想起他们的笑容。

heart.definition:
n. the locus of feelings and intuitions
n. the hollow muscular organ located behind the sternum and between the lungs; its rhythmic contractions move the blood through the body
n. the courage to carry on
n. an inclination or tendency of a certain kind
heart.translation: n. 心, 心脏, 中心, 内心, 感情, 精神, 心情, 宝贝儿\nvt. 鼓励

examples.en: It's only you in my heart, just you, only you.
examples.zh: 我心里只有你、你、还是你。

examples.en: He learnt the periodic table by heart just for fun.
examples.zh: 他背周期表只是为了好玩。

examples.en: She had no difficulty in learning the poem by heart.
examples.zh: 她轻而易举的就把诗背熟了。

heat.definition:
n. a form of energy that is transferred by a difference in temperature
n. the sensation caused by heat energy
n. the trait of being intensely emotional
n. a preliminary race in which the winner advances to a more important race
heat.translation: n. 热, 热度, 体温, 高潮\nvi. 加热, 激昂, 加剧\nvt. 把...加热, 使激动

examples.en: The heat is making me crave for an ice cream.
examples.zh: 热得想吃冰淇淋。

examples.en: In the village we still heat our homes with wood.
examples.zh: 在村庄里，我们还是用木头给房子取暖。

examples.en: They went to Edinburgh to escape from the summer heat.
examples.zh: 他们去了爱丁堡避暑。

heavy.definition:
n. an actor who plays villainous roles
n. a serious (or tragic) role in a play
a. of comparatively great physical weight or density
a. unusually great in degree or quantity or number
heavy.translation: a. 重的, 巨大的, 沉重的, 笨重的, 过度的\nadv. 沉重地\nn. 重物, 严肃角色

examples.en: Why do children have to carry such a heavy bag?
examples.zh: 为什么小朋友得背这么重的书包呢?

examples.en: The rain wasn't heavy enough to put out the fire.
examples.zh: 雨没大到能把火浇灭。

examples.en: The bag was too heavy for me to move.
examples.zh: 那个袋子太重了，我拿不动。

hedge.definition:
n. a fence formed by a row of closely planted shrubs or bushes
n. any technique designed to reduce or eliminate financial risk; for example, taking two positions that will offset each other if prices change
n. an intentionally noncommittal or ambiguous statement
v. avoid or try to avoid fulfilling, answering, or performing (duties, questions, or issues)
hedge.translation:
n. 树篱, 障碍, 套头交易
vt. 用树篱围, 套期保值, 妨碍, 两面下注以防...的损失
vi. 筑树篱, 躲闪, 两面下注以防损失
a. 树篱的, 偷偷摸摸的

examples.en: The cat got through the hedge.
examples.zh: 猫从树篱穿过去。

height.definition: n. the vertical dimension of extension; distance from the base of something to the top
height.translation: n. 高度, 海拔, 高地, 顶点\n[化] 高度

examples.en: The teacher lined the children up in order of height.
examples.zh: 老师按照身高给孩子们排队。

examples.en: I wish I was the same height as Tom.
examples.zh: 我想和Tom一样高。

examples.en: My little brother and I are the same height.
examples.zh: 我弟弟和我一样高。

heighten.definition: v. become more extreme\nv. make more extreme; raise in quantity, degree, or intensity\nv. increase the height of
heighten.translation: vt. 增高, 提高, 加强\nvi. 升高, 变大

examples.en: To cause laughter without joining in greatly heightens the effect.
It seems common for teens to have heightened urges.
The risk of fire is heightened in low-energy houses.

heir.definition: n. a person who is entitled by law or by the terms of a will to inherit the estate of another
heir.translation: n. 继承人, 嗣子, 后嗣\n[法] 继承人, 后嗣

examples.en: Tom is the son and heir to the Japanese ryokan.
The king's eldest son is the heir to the throne.
Michael has an heir to take over the family business.

helicopter.definition: n. an aircraft without wings that obtains its lift from the rotation of overhead blades
helicopter.translation: n. 直升机\nvt. 由直升机运送\nvi. 乘直升机

examples.en: The government transported goods to the island by helicopter.
examples.zh: 政府用直升机把物资送到了那个小岛。

examples.en: Tell those people to back off so that the helicopter can land.
examples.zh: 叫那些人后退，直升机要著陆了。

examples.en: Tom waved at Mary from the helicopter.
examples.zh: 汤姆在直升机上向玛丽挥手。

hell.definition:
n. any place of pain and turmoil; 
n. a cause of difficulty and suffering
n. (Christianity) the abode of Satan and the forces of evil; where sinners suffer eternal punishment
n. (religion) the world of the dead
hell.translation: n. 地狱, 邪恶势力, 苦境, 阴间, 毁坏, 训斥\nvi. 狂饮, 飞驰

examples.en: What the hell are you going to do with it?
examples.zh: 你到底要对它怎么样？

examples.en: Hell is empty, and all the devils are here!
examples.zh: 地狱空空荡荡，魔鬼都在人间。

examples.en: The road to hell is paved with good intentions.
examples.zh: 通往地狱的路，都是由善意铺成的。

help.definition:
v. give help or assistance; be of service
v. improve the condition of
v. be of use
v. contribute to the furtherance of
help.translation:
n. 帮忙, 帮助者, 补救办法, 有益的东西
vt. 帮助, 帮忙, 接济, 治疗, 款待
vi. 有用, 救命, 招待
[计] 帮助, 帮助程序; DOS外部命令: DOS命令的电子文件帮助程序

examples.en: It was foolish of her to ask him for help.
examples.zh: 她去找他帮忙，实在不是一个明智之举。

examples.en: I feel like I am being forced to help her.
examples.zh: 我感觉我被强制帮助她。

examples.en: I will help him to the best of my ability.
examples.zh: 我将会尽我所能地帮助他。

helpful.definition: a. providing assistance or serving a useful function
helpful.translation: a. 有帮助的, 有益的, 有用的

examples.en: He may be clever, but he is not very helpful.
examples.zh: 他很聪明，但却不太帮得上忙。

examples.en: It would be helpful if you could do that for me.
examples.zh: 您那样做的话，可就帮到我了。

examples.en: When learning Chinese, pinyin is very helpful for beginners.
examples.zh: 学习汉语的时候，拼音对初学者很有帮助。

hemisphere.definition: n. half of the terrestrial globe\nn. half of a sphere\nn. either half of the cerebrum
hemisphere.translation: n. 半球, 地球的半面, 大脑半球\n[医] 半球

examples.en: Japan is located in the Northern Hemisphere.
examples.zh: 日本位于北半球。

examples.en: The equator divides the globe into two hemispheres.
examples.zh: 赤道把地球分为两个半球。

examples.en: The equator divides the earth into two hemispheres.
examples.zh: 赤道把地球分为两个半球。

hence.definition: r. from this place\nr. from this time

examples.en: Hence, we have to take care of ourselves.
examples.zh: 因此，我们必须自己照顾自己。

examples.en: He did everything to be able to survive, hence he never wants to talk about it.
examples.zh: 他为了活下去竭尽全力，所以他从来不想谈起这件事。

herb.definition: n. a plant lacking a permanent woody stem; many are flowering garden plants or potherbs; some having medicinal properties; some are pests\nn. aromatic potherb used in cookery for its savory qualities
herb.translation: n. 药草, 香草\n[医] 草, 草本, 草药

examples.en: The herb used in that pasta sauce might be parsley.
examples.zh: 用于那个义大利酱的香草可能是荷兰芹。

herd.definition:
n. a group of cattle or sheep or other domestic mammals all of the same kind that are herded by humans
n. a group of wild mammals of one species that remain together: antelope or elephants or seals or whales or zebra
v. cause to herd, drive, or crowd together
v. move together, like a herd
herd.translation: n. 兽群, 人群, 牧人\nvt. 群集, 使成群, 放牧\nvi. 聚在一起

examples.en: The newborn calf couldn't catch up with the herd running from the jaguar.
examples.zh: 新生小牛跟不上逃离美洲虎的牛群。

examples.en: It's time for the Tuaregs to transfer their herds to the valley.
examples.zh: 图阿雷格人该把他们的牲畜转移到山谷去了。

heritage.definition: n. practices that are handed down from the past by tradition
heritage.translation: n. 遗产, 祖先遗留物, 继承物\n[医] 遗传性

examples.en: Ironbridge Gorge is a Unesco world heritage site.
examples.zh: 铁桥峡谷是联合国教科文组织世界遗产。

examples.en: Is it true that our genetic heritage is almost the same as that of chimpanzees?
examples.zh: 我们的遗传基因真的和黑猩猩几乎一样吗？

hero.definition:
n. a man distinguished by exceptional courage and nobility and strength
n. the principal character in a play or movie or novel or poem
n. Greek mathematician and inventor who devised a way to determine the area of a triangle and who described various mechanical devices (first century)
n. (classical mythology) a being of great strength and courage celebrated for bold exploits; often the offspring of a mortal and a god
hero.translation: n. 英雄, 超越常人者, 男主角

examples.en: We called him a "hero", but he betrayed us.
examples.zh: 我们把他称为“英雄”，但是他却背叛了我们。

examples.en: He dreamed of being a hero.
examples.zh: 他梦想着成为一名英雄。

examples.en: In spite of the tyrant’s persecution, the hero valiantly carried on the struggle.
examples.zh: 尽管受到暴君的迫害，英雄还顽强地斗争。

heroic.definition: a. relating to or characteristic of heroes of antiquity\ns. having or displaying qualities appropriate for heroes
heroic.translation: a. 英勇的, 英雄式的, 壮丽雄伟的\nn. 英雄诗, 史诗, 英勇行为

examples.en: Matt Walsh considers the Native American genocide "good and heroic."
It was heroic of them to oppose the enemy.
The heroic man is described as a thoroughbred horse.

hesitate.definition: v. pause or hold back in uncertainty or unwillingness\nv. interrupt temporarily an activity before continuing
hesitate.translation: vi. 犹豫, 迟疑, 踌躇, 支吾, 停顿

examples.en: Reporters do not hesitate to intrude into people's privacy.
examples.zh: 记者没有犹豫地去干涉了人们的私生活。

examples.en: When facing this opportunity, you can't hesitate to take advantage of it.
examples.zh: 面对这个机会不能犹豫，要赶快行动。

examples.en: Don't hesitate to ask questions.
examples.zh: 不要犹豫去问问题。

hesitation.definition: n. indecision in speech or action\nn. the act of pausing uncertainly
hesitation.translation: n. 犹豫, 踌躇, 含糊, 口吃, 暂停\n[计] 暂停

examples.en: After some hesitation, he laid the book on the desk.
examples.zh: 犹豫了片刻之后，他把书放在了桌子上。

examples.en: Without the slightest hesitation, he sold his own car.
examples.zh: 他毫不犹豫地把自己的车卖了。

examples.en: I would marry you without hesitation.
examples.zh: 我会毫不犹豫嫁给你。

hide.definition:
n. the dressed skin of an animal (especially a large animal)
n. body covering of a living animal
v. prevent from being seen or discovered
v. be or go into hiding; keep out of sight, as for protection and safety
hide.translation:
n. 兽皮, 迹象, 躲藏处
vt. 藏, 隐瞒, 遮避, 剥...的皮, 隐藏
vi. 躲藏
[计] 隐藏

examples.en: Tom couldn't think of a good place to hide it.
examples.zh: 汤姆想不到个好地方藏它。

examples.en: We often hide our thoughts in front of others.
examples.zh: 我们通常会对其他人隐瞒自己的想法.

examples.en: Why are you trying to hide your feelings?
examples.zh: 为什么你要试图隐藏自己的情感？

hierarchy.definition: n. a series of ordered groupings of people or things within a system\nn. the organization of people at different ranks in an administrative body
hierarchy.translation: n. 等级制度, 僧侣统治, 等级体系\n[计] 分级结构; 分层结构; 新闻组, 新闻组分层

examples.en: There's a very rigid hierarchy in the Civil Service.
Dominance hierarchy is a key part of animal behavior.
The hierarchy of rank has long been fixed.

high.definition:
n. a lofty level or position or degree
n. an air mass of higher than normal pressure
n. a state of sustained elation
n. a state of altered consciousness induced by alcohol or narcotics
high.translation: n. 高度, 高处\na. 高的, 高级的, 主要的, 高尚的, 高原的, 高音的, 昂贵的, 傲慢的\nadv. 高度地, 奢侈地

examples.en: Benedito gave out high fives to fans in the queue.
examples.zh: 贝内迪托与排队的粉丝们击掌。

examples.en: It's already eleven. It's high time you were in bed.
examples.zh: 十一时了，你该上床睡觉了。

examples.en: It's sort of fashionable, but the price is too high!
examples.zh: 虽然时髦一点，但是价钱太大！

highlight.definition: n. the most interesting or memorable part\nn. an area of lightness in a picture\nv. apply a highlighter to one's cheeks or eyebrows in order to make them more prominent
highlight.translation: n. 加亮区, 精彩场面\nvt. 加亮, 使显著, 以强光照射, 突出\n[计] 突出

examples.en: For Tom, this moment was the highlight of the day.
The star-shaped cake was the highlight of Adriano's birthday party.
They will highlight various aspects of mobile services in Bangladesh.

highly.definition: r. to a high degree or extent; favorably or with much respect\nr. at a high rate or wage\nr. in a high position or level or rank
highly.translation: adv. 非常, 非常赞许地\n[电] 大大地

examples.en: Norway, located in Northern Europe, is a highly developed country.
examples.zh: 挪威位于北欧，是个高度发展的国家。

examples.en: I know that it is highly unlikely that anyone knows me.
examples.zh: 我知道有人认识我的可能性微乎其微。

examples.en: The family was highly doubtful of the statement from the military.
examples.zh: 家属对军方的说法高度置疑。

highway.definition: n. a major road for any form of motor transport
highway.translation: n. 公路, 大道, 捷径\n[法] 公路, 大路

examples.en: In Austria, you have to pay to use the highway.
examples.zh: 奥地利的高速公路是收费的。

examples.en: Traffic conditions on the highway are normal this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上高速公路上的交通状况正常。

examples.en: Do you want to take the highway?
examples.zh: 要不要上高架走？

hike.definition: n. a long walk usually for exercise or pleasure\nv. increase\nv. walk a long way, as for pleasure or physical exercise
hike.translation: n. 徒步旅行, 远足, 涨价, 提高\nvi. 步行, 徒步旅行, 上升\nvt. 使高涨, 拉起

examples.en: The man is hiking on a narrow path.
examples.zh: 他在一条狭窄的道路上走。

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go hiking.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雨的话，我们就不去爬山了。

examples.en: We should cancel the hike.
examples.zh: 我们应该取消这次远足。

hilarious.definition: s. marked by or causing boisterous merriment or convulsive laughter
hilarious.translation: a. 喜不自禁的, 欢闹的, 引人发笑的

examples.en: The laser cow in WHAT THE CAR? is both hilarious and terrifying!
examples.zh: 《WHAT THE CAR?》中的雷射奶牛又好笑又吓人！

examples.en: I try not to laugh at my own jokes, but we all know I'm hilarious.
examples.zh: 我尽量不对我自己的笑话发笑，但是我们都知道我很搞笑。

hill.definition:
n. a local and well-defined elevation of the land
n. United States railroad tycoon (1838-1916)
n. risque English comedian (1925-1992)
v. form into a hill
hill.translation: n. 小山, 丘陵, 小土堆\nvt. 作成土堆, 堆成小丘

examples.en: There was a cottage on the side of the hill.
examples.zh: 山坡上有一个茅屋。

examples.en: He was walking up the hill at a steady pace.
examples.zh: 他迈着稳健的步伐登上了山丘。

examples.en: Seen from a distance, the hill looks like an elephant.
examples.zh: Cóng yuǎnchù kàn，nàzuòshān xiàng yìtóu dàxiàng。 从远处看，那座山像一头大象。

hinder.definition:
v be a hindrance or obstacle to
v hinder or prevent the progress or accomplishment of
v put at a disadvantage
s located at or near the back of an animal
s located at or near the back of an animal
hinder.translation: a. 后面的\nv. 阻碍, 打扰

examples.en: Nothing will hinder my malicious plan.
examples.zh: 没有什么能阻碍我邪恶的计划。

hint.definition: n. an indirect suggestion\nn. a slight indication\nv. drop a hint; intimate by a hint
hint.translation: n. 暗示, 提示\nv. 暗示, 示意

examples.en: Would you give me a hint?
examples.zh: 你可以给我一个提示吗？

examples.en: What are you hinting at?
examples.zh: 你在暗示什么？

examples.en: Anna's striking almond-shaped eyes, inherited from her Asian lineage, exude a captivating depth and a hint of mystery.
examples.zh: 安娜引人注目的杏仁状眼睛继承了她的亚洲血统，散发著迷人的深度和一丝神秘感。

hire.definition: n. a newly hired employee\nn. the act of hiring something or someone\nv. engage or hire for work
hire.translation: n. 租金, 租用, 雇用\nvt. 雇请, 出租\nvi. 受雇

examples.en: If he's fluent in English, I'll hire him.
examples.zh: 如果他说得一口流利的英文，我就请他为我工作。

examples.en: Private detectives were hired to look into the strange case.
examples.zh: 私家侦探们受雇调查这桩奇怪的案件。

examples.en: I would like to hire a car.
examples.zh: 我想租一辆车。

historic.definition: s. belonging to the past; of what is important or famous in the past\ns. important in history
historic.translation: a. 历史上著名的, 有历史性的

examples.en: There are many famous historic buildings in Kyoto.
examples.zh: 京都有很多有名的古建筑。

examples.en: He set out on his historic voyage.
examples.zh: 他开始了他历史性的航程。

examples.en: This is a historic city.
examples.zh: 这是一座古城。

historical.definition: a. of or relating to the study of history\ns. having once lived or existed or taken place in the real world as distinct from being legendary
historical.translation: a. 历史的, 史实的, 历史上的\n[法] 历史性的

examples.en: A historical landmark has been restored and will reopen.
examples.zh: 一座历史地标已经修复并将重新开放。

examples.en: Many important historical events took place 7000 years B.C.
examples.zh: 公元前七千年那段时间发生了很多重要的历史事件。

examples.en: This is a city of real historical value.
examples.zh: 这是一个具有历史价值的城市。

history.definition:
n. the aggregate of past events
n. a record or narrative description of past events
n. the discipline that records and interprets past events involving human beings
n. the continuum of events occurring in succession leading from the past to the present and even into the future
history.translation: n. 历史, 过去, 经历, 发展过程, 历史学, 过去的事, 历史记录\n[计] 历史记录

examples.en: The history of China is older than that of Japan.
examples.zh: 中国历史比日本历史更悠久。

examples.en: This year is definitely a special year in human history.
examples.zh: 今年肯定是人类历史上特殊的一年。

examples.en: The space race was an exciting time in history.
examples.zh: 太空竞赛是历史上激动人心的时期。

hit.definition:
n. (baseball) a successful stroke in an athletic contest (especially in baseball)
n. the act of contacting one thing with another
n. a conspicuous success
n. a dose of a narcotic drug
hit.translation:
n. 打击, 打, 冲撞, 讽刺
vt. 打, 打击, 碰撞, 打中, 袭击, 偶然碰上
vi. 打, 打中, 打击, 碰撞, 偶然碰上
[计] 击中; 找到; 瞬时打扰

examples.en: I have a very sore arm where you hit me.
examples.zh: 你打在我手臂上的地方超级痛。

examples.en: A cold wave of fear hit me like a brick.
examples.zh: 一阵寒意像砖头一样击中了我。

examples.en: A massive earthquake of magnitude 8.8 hit the Japanese islands today.
examples.zh: 今天，8.8级的强大地震袭击了日本的岛屿。

hobby.definition: n. a child's plaything consisting of an imitation horse mounted on rockers; the child straddles it and pretends to ride\nn. small Old World falcon formerly trained and flown at small birds
hobby.translation: n. 嗜好, 癖好, 爱好

examples.en: My hobby is taking pictures of wild flowers.
examples.zh: 我的业余爱好是拍野花的照片。

examples.en: His hobby is painting pictures of flowers.
examples.zh: 他的爱好是画有花的图。

examples.en: My hobbies are not only wide-ranging but also useful.
examples.zh: 我的爱好不但广泛而且有用。

hoist.definition:
n. lifting device for raising heavy or cumbersome objects
v. raise or haul up with or as if with mechanical help
v. move from one place to another by lifting
v. raise
hoist.translation: n. 升高, 起重机, 推动\nv. 升起, 升高, 举起

examples.en: This hoist is used to lift heavy car parts.
We went out to hoist a few beers.
Hoist your sail when the wind is fair.

hold.definition:
n. power by which something or someone is affected or dominated
n. a stronghold
n. a cell in a jail or prison
v. have or hold in one's hands or grip
hold.translation:
n. 把握, 把持力, 柄, 控制, 掌握, 监禁
vt. 保存, 握住, 拿住, 占据, 持有, 拥有
vi. 支持, 持续, 有效
n. 保留
[计] 保留

examples.en: I want to be able to hold my liquor better.
examples.zh: 想酒量大一些。

examples.en: That box is too small to hold all these things.
examples.zh: 那个箱子太小了，装不下这么多的东西。

examples.en: That's too small a box to hold all these things.
examples.zh: 那个箱子太小了，放不下这里这么多东西。

hole.definition:
n. an opening into or through something
n. an opening deliberately made in or through something
n. one playing period (from tee to green) on a golf course
n. an unoccupied space
hole.translation: n. 孔, 洞, 穴, 漏洞\nvt. 挖洞, 掘坑\nvi. 进洞, 凿洞

examples.en: Only a shoe knows about a hole in a sock.
examples.zh: 只有鞋子知道袜子的洞。

examples.en: The child has picked a hole in his new jumper.
examples.zh: 孩子的新毛衣上勾了一个洞。

examples.en: He has patched up the hole in the wall.
examples.zh: 他把墙壁的洞补好了。

holiday.definition: n. a day on which work is suspended by law or custom
holiday.translation: n. 假日, 假期, 节日\nvi. 度假

examples.en: She was happy to come, but she was on holiday.
examples.zh: 她很乐意前来，但是她在休假。

examples.en: Christmas was my favorite holiday when I was a kid.
examples.zh: 我小时候，最喜欢的节日是圣诞节。

examples.en: I plan to spend the New Year's holiday in Australia.
examples.zh: 我打算在澳大利亚过新年。

hollow.definition:
n. a cavity or space in something
n. a small valley between mountains
v. remove the interior of
a. not solid; having a space or gap or cavity
hollow.translation:
n. 洞, 窟窿, 山谷
a. 空的, 虚伪的, 空腹的, 凹的
vi. 形成空洞
vt. 挖空

examples.en: The fox hid in the hollow tree.
examples.zh: 狐狸躲在了空心树里面。

examples.en: My life is hollow without him.
examples.zh: 没有他我的生活是空虚的。

examples.en: A water drop hollows a stone not by force but by falling often.
examples.zh: 滴水穿石，不是靠力量，而是靠时间。

holy.definition: a. belonging to or derived from or associated with a divine power
holy.translation: a. 神圣的, 圣洁的, 至善的\nn. 神圣的东西

examples.en: Jerusalem is the Holy City of the Jews.
examples.zh: 耶路撒冷是犹太人的圣城。

examples.en: The man on whom you see the Spirit come down and remain is he who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.
examples.zh: 你如果看见圣灵降下，落在谁身上，谁就是用圣灵替人施洗的了。

homework.definition: n. preparatory school work done outside school (especially at home)
homework.translation: n. 家庭作业, 家里做的工作\n[经] 家庭作业

examples.en: Tom was the first one to turn in his homework.
examples.zh: 汤姆是第一个交作业的。

examples.en: I read the book after I had finished my homework.
examples.zh: 我做完我的功课后，就读这本书。

examples.en: This is the book I read after finishing my homework.
examples.zh: 我做完我的功课后，就读这本书。

homogeneous.definition: a. all of the same or similar kind or nature
homogeneous.translation: a. 同种的, 同质的, 齐性的\n[医] 同种的, 纯一的, 同质的, 均匀的

examples.en: Any homogeneous cycle has a period and a frequency.
Conformity is an essential element of our homogeneous community.
It's a heterogeneous group, not a homogeneous one.

honest.definition:
a. not disposed to cheat or defraud; not deceptive or fraudulent
s. without dissimulation; frank
s. without pretensions
s. marked by truth
honest.translation: a. 诚实的, 坦直的, 可靠的

examples.en: Tom is too honest a boy to tell a lie.
examples.zh: 汤姆太老实了，连撒谎都不会。

examples.en: So far as I know, he is an honest man.
examples.zh: 据我所知，他是一个诚实的人。

examples.en: Mark is so honest that everyone praises him for it.
examples.zh: 马克是如此的诚实所以每个人都称赞他。

honesty.definition: n. the quality of being honest\nn. southeastern European plant cultivated for its fragrant purplish flowers and round flat papery silver-white seedpods that are used for indoor decoration
honesty.translation: n. 诚实, 公正, 正直

examples.en: Honesty was the most important factor in his success.
examples.zh: 诚实是他成功最重要的因素。

examples.en: Honesty is the primary reason for his success.
examples.zh: 诚实是他成功的主要原因。

examples.en: Honesty is not always the best policy.
examples.zh: 诚实不总是最好的策略。

honor.definition: n. the state of being honored\nn. the quality of being honorable and having a good name\nn. a woman's virtue or chastity
honor.translation: n. 荣誉, 头衔, 信用, 尊敬, 名誉, 阁下, 勋章\nvt. 尊敬, 授予荣誉, 承兑, 实践

examples.en: A farewell meeting was held in honor of Mr Jones.
examples.zh: 举行了一场欢送会以纪念琼斯先生。

examples.en: I felt that my honor was at stake.
examples.zh: 我觉得我的名誉受到了威胁。

examples.en: Throughout Heaven and Earth, I alone am the honored one.
examples.zh: 天上天下，唯我独尊。

hook.definition:
n. a catch for locking a door
n. a sharp curve or crook; a shape resembling a hook
n. a mechanical device that is curved or bent to suspend or hold or pull something
n. a curved or bent implement for suspending or pulling something
hook.translation:
n. 钩, 钩状, 镰刀, 陷阱
vt. 挂...于钩上, 钩住, 引上钩, 偷窃
vi. 弯成钩状, 钩紧
[计] 钩

examples.en: Tom hung his shirt on a coat hook.
examples.zh: 汤姆将他的衬衣挂在了挂钩上。

examples.en: He asked me to do what I can to hook them up.
examples.zh: 他求我尽力去帮他搭桥拉线。

examples.en: Ziri put up hooks for gardening tools in the garage.
examples.zh: 齐里在车库里装上了用来挂园艺工具的挂钩。

hope.definition:
n. a specific instance of feeling hopeful
n. the general feeling that some desire will be fulfilled
n. someone (or something) on which expectations are centered
n. United States comedian (born in England) who appeared in films with Bing Crosby (1903-2003)
hope.translation: n. 希望, 信心, 期待\nv. 希望, 期望, 信赖

examples.en: Hope to see you next time I'm in N.Y.
examples.zh: 希望下次在纽约见到你。

examples.en: I hope we will be able to keep in touch.
examples.zh: 希望我们能够保持联络吧。

examples.en: I hope we don't have to wait for too long.
examples.zh: 希望我们不需要等太久。

hopeful.translation: n. 有希望之人, 有前途之人\na. 有希望的, 怀抱希望的, 保持乐观的

examples.en: I feel hopeful about the future.
examples.zh: 我对未来感到有希望。

hopeless.definition:
a. without hope because there seems to be no possibility of comfort or success
s. of a person unable to do something skillfully
s. certain to fail
s. (informal to emphasize how bad it is) beyond hope of management or reform
hopeless.translation: a. 无希望的, 绝望的, 不可救药的

examples.en: By the way, my English is absolutely hopeless.
examples.zh: 顺道一提，我的英语是绝对没有希望了。

examples.en: The situation has become hopeless.
examples.zh: 情况变得没有希望了。

examples.en: He's a hopeless case.
examples.zh: 他是个无可救药的家伙。

horizon.definition:
n. the line at which the sky and Earth appear to meet
n. the range of interest or activity that can be anticipated
n. a specific layer or stratum of soil or subsoil in a vertical cross section of land
n. the great circle on the celestial sphere whose plane passes through the sensible horizon and the center of the Earth
horizon.translation: n. 地平线, 眼界, (天)视地平

examples.en: The sun has just sunk below the horizon.
examples.zh: 太阳刚下山。

examples.en: The sun rose over the horizon.
examples.zh: 太阳升出了地平线。

examples.en: The moon was above the horizon.
examples.zh: 月亮已从地平线升起了。

horizontal.definition: n. something that is oriented horizontally\na. parallel to or in the plane of the horizon or a base line
horizontal.translation:
n. 水平线, 水平面, 水平位置
a. 水平线的, 平坦的, 横的
n. 水平
[计] 水平

examples.en: The stripes were horizontal.
examples.zh: 条纹是水平的。

horn.definition:
n. a noisemaker (as at parties or games) that makes a loud noise when you blow through it
n. one of the bony outgrowths on the heads of certain ungulates
n. a noise made by the driver of an automobile to give warning; 
n. a high pommel of a Western saddle (usually metal covered with leather)
horn.translation: n. 角, 角质, 喇叭, 号角\na. 角制的\nvt. 用角触, 长角于

examples.en: This may sound like blowing my own horn, but ...
examples.zh: 这听起来可能像是我在自吹自擂, 但是...

examples.en: Viking helmets with horns aren't in style in Scandinavia anymore.
examples.zh: 斯堪的纳维亚现在已经不流行戴维京人那种有角的头盔了。

examples.en: The train slowed and blared its horn as it approached the railway crossing.
examples.zh: 火车在快到交叉路口的时候减速、按喇叭。

horrible.translation: a. 可怕的, 遭透的, 极讨厌的

examples.en: The other day something horrible happened in a Tokyo suburb.
examples.zh: 前几天，东京郊外发生了件可怕的事情。

examples.en: I just wish we could leave this horrible place.
examples.zh: 我只是希望我们能离开这个可怕的地方。

examples.en: I had a horrible dream last night.
examples.zh: 我昨晚做了一个恶梦。

horrify.definition: v fill with apprehension or alarm; cause to be unpleasantly surprised
horrify.translation: vt. 使恐惧, 使震惊

examples.en: In a horrifying chain of events, Christopher Columbus once bit his own lip.
examples.zh: 在一连串可怕的事件中, 哥伦布曾经咬紧牙关撑过去。

horror.definition: n. intense and profound fear\nn. something that inspires dislike; something horrible
horror.translation: n. 惊骇, 恐怖, 惨状\n[医] 恐怖, 恐惧

examples.en: To my horror, the man took a gun out of his pocket.
examples.zh: 男子从口袋中掏出枪，吓了我一跳。

examples.en: I'm going to see a horror film.
examples.zh: 我要去看恐怖电影。

examples.en: This horror movie is really scary. I couldn't sleep after I watched it.
examples.zh: 这部恐怖片很吓人，我一看就睡不着觉了。

horse.definition: n. solid-hoofed herbivorous quadruped domesticated since prehistoric times\nn. a padded gymnastic apparatus on legs\nv. provide with a horse or horses
horse.translation: n. 马, 骑兵, 脚架\nvi. 骑马, 取笑\nvt. 使骑马, 系马于

examples.en: He likes to get on the horse and go out.
examples.zh: 他喜欢骑马出行。

examples.en: This boy is riding a horse for the first time.
examples.zh: 这男孩第一次骑在马上。

examples.en: The boy rode a horse for the first time.
examples.zh: 男孩第一次骑了马。

hospital.definition: n. a health facility where patients receive treatment\nn. a medical institution where sick or injured people are given medical or surgical care

examples.en: I went to the hospital to have my eyes tested.
examples.zh: 我到医院去检查了眼睛。

examples.en: He was kind enough to take me to the hospital.
examples.zh: 他好心地把我送到医院。

examples.en: Three streets, as well as a park and a hospital.
examples.zh: 三条马路，还有医院和公园。

hospitality.definition: n kindness in welcoming guests or strangers
hospitality.translation: n. 款待, 亲切, 殷勤

examples.en: All the guests were touched by her hospitality.
examples.zh: 所有的客人都被她的好客感动了。

host.definition:
n. a person who invites guests to a social event (such as a party in his or her own home) and who is responsible for them while they are there
n. an animal or plant that nourishes and supports a parasite; it does not benefit and is often harmed by the association
n. archaic terms for army
n. any organization that provides resources and facilities for a function or event
host.translation: n. 主人, 旅馆老板, 节目主持人\nvt. 当主人招待, 作...节目主持人\n[计] 主机, 宿主机

examples.en: A guest should not try to make himself superior to the host.
examples.zh: 强宾不压主。

examples.en: The party host had a Portuguese accent.
examples.zh: 派对主席说话时有葡萄牙腔

examples.en: Euro 2012 is being hosted jointly by Poland and Ukraine.
examples.zh: 波兰与乌克兰两国一起举办2012年欧洲足球锦标赛。

hostage.definition: n. a prisoner who is held by one party to insure that another party will meet specified terms
hostage.translation: n. 人质, 抵押品\n[经] 人质, 抵押品

examples.en: Russia expresses regret for those lost in the hostage incident.
examples.zh: 俄罗斯对在人质事件中牺牲的人们表示哀悼。

examples.en: The criminal didn't let the hostages go.
examples.zh: 罪犯没有放人质们走。

examples.en: The hostages will be released tomorrow.
examples.zh: 人质将在明天获释。

hostile.definition:
n. troops belonging to the enemy's military forces
a. characterized by enmity or ill will
a. not belonging to your own country's forces or those of an ally
s. impossible to bring into friendly accord
hostile.translation: a. 敌人的, 怀敌意的, 敌对的\nn. 敌对分子

examples.en: We, ACME Ltd., hereby announce that we will resist with all our strength this hostile takeover.
examples.zh: 我们ACME有限公司，特此宣布，我们将尽我们的力量抵制这种恶意收购。

hot.definition:
a. used of physical heat; having a high or higher than desirable temperature or giving off heat or feeling or causing a sensation of heat or burning
s. characterized by violent and forceful activity or movement; very intense
a. extended meanings; especially of psychological heat; marked by intensity or vehemence especially of passion or enthusiasm
s. (color) bold and intense
hot.translation: a. 热的, 热心的, 辣的, 热情的, 激动的, 猛烈的, 紧迫的\nadv. 热, 紧迫地

examples.en: Hot and humid weather puts me in a bad mood.
examples.zh: 天气一闷热，我的心情就不好。

examples.en: There is nothing like cold beer on a hot day.
examples.zh: 炎炎夏日来杯冰凉的啤酒，人生一乐也！

examples.en: The potato was so hot that it burned my mouth.
examples.zh: 土豆太热，以至于烫到了我的嘴。

hotel.definition: n. a building where travelers can pay for lodging and meals and other services

examples.en: Do you know of a cheap hotel in the area?
examples.zh: 您知道这附近有便宜的旅馆吗？

examples.en: I want to stay in a hotel near the airport.
examples.zh: 我想住在机场附近的旅馆里。

examples.en: How far is it from the airport to the hotel?
examples.zh: 从机场到旅馆多远？

hour.definition:
n. a period of time equal to 1/24th of a day
n. clock time
n. a special and memorable period
n. distance measured by the time taken to cover it
hour.translation: n. 小时, 钟头, 时间, ...点钟, 课时

examples.en: Will you lend me your CD player for an hour?
examples.zh: 你能借我你的CD播放机一小时吗？

examples.en: I can't absorb all of the lesson in an hour.
examples.zh: 我不能一小时内彻底的了解那堂课程。

examples.en: You should have started an hour and a half ago.
examples.zh: 你一个半小时以前就应该开始了。

house.definition:
n. a dwelling that serves as living quarters for one or more families
n. the members of a religious community living together
n. the audience gathered together in a theatre or cinema
n. an official assembly having legislative powers
house.translation: n. 房子, 住宅, 机构, 议院, 家族, 家庭\nvt. 给...房子住, 收藏\nvi. 住, 躲藏

examples.en: This is a house to let, not to be sold.
examples.zh: 这是一栋只出租不出售的房子。

examples.en: I'd buy a new house if I had the money.
examples.zh: 如果我有钱，我会买一个新房子。

examples.en: I think it's time for me to buy a house.
examples.zh: 我想我该是时候买间房子了。

household.definition: n a social unit living together
household.translation: n. 一家人, 家庭, 家族, 王室\na. 家庭的, 家常的, 王室的

examples.en: More and more married couples share household chores.
examples.zh: 夫妻分担家务的情况愈来愈普遍。

examples.en: However, I've never been a guest in an English household that wasn't generous.
examples.zh: 不过，我从来没有在一个小气的英国家庭做过客。

examples.en: Nowadays, equal pay is not enough. Household responsibilities must also be distributed evenly.
examples.zh: 现在不止要男女薪金平等，而且还要平均分配家务。

housing.definition: n. structures collectively in which people are housed\nn. a protective cover designed to contain or support a mechanical component
housing.translation: n. 遮盖, 住房供给, 居留(处), 房屋, 装饰\n[化] 外壳

examples.en: The government is not doing its best to solve the housing problem.
examples.zh: 政府没有尽他们最大的努力去处理住房问题。

examples.en: Housing prices in Hsinchu City have risen sharply due to the concentration of the tech industry.
examples.zh: 新竹市区的房价因为科技产业聚集而水涨船高。

hover.definition: v. be undecided about something; waver between conflicting positions or courses of action\nv. move to and fro\nv. hang in the air; fly or be suspended above
hover.translation: vi. 盘旋, 翱翔, 徘徊\nvt. 孵\nn. 翱翔

examples.en: The temperature of the human body hovers around 37°C.
examples.zh: 人体的平均温度在37°C上下浮动。

howl.definition:
n. a long loud emotional utterance
n. the long plaintive cry of a hound or a wolf
n. a loud sustained noise resembling the cry of a hound
v. emit long loud cries
howl.translation: n. 嗥叫, 吠声, 号叫\nvi. 狂吠, 咆哮, 呼啸\nvt. 对...吼叫, 狂喊着说

examples.en: The wind is howling outside the window.
examples.zh: 大风在窗外呼呼作响。

examples.en: The demon grabbed my sister and, with howling laughter, cast her into a bottomless pit.
examples.zh: 恶魔一把抓住了我的妹妹，一边狰狞地狂笑着，一边把她丢进了一个无底洞里。

hub.definition: n. the central part of a car wheel (or fan or propeller etc) through which the shaft or axle passes\nn. a center of activity or interest or commerce or transportation; a focal point around which events revolve
hub.translation: n. 毂, 木片, 中心\n[计] 插座; 插孔; 集线器, 集中器, 连接器, 中继站

examples.en: Zürich is considered to be a major financial hub.
Algeria could become an energy hub in the near future.
The Sahara Desert has become a hub for terrorist groups.

huddle.definition:
n. (informal) a quick private conference
n. a disorganized and densely packed crowd
v. crowd or draw together
v. crouch or curl up
huddle.translation: n. 杂乱一团, 混乱, 拥挤\nvt. 把...挤在一起, 乱堆, 草率了事, 蜷曲\nvi. 挤作一团, 蜷缩

examples.en: The wolves saved Tom from freezing by huddling around him.
The children were huddled about the fire in shivering groups.
We all huddled in the corner of the room.

hug.definition: n. a tight or amorous embrace\nv. fit closely or tightly
hug.translation: n. 紧抱, 拥抱\nvt. 紧抱, 坚持, 使沾沾自喜

examples.en: Do you still want to give me a hug?
examples.zh: 你还想拥抱我一下吗？

examples.en: Is it OK if I hug you?
examples.zh: 我能抱你吗？

examples.en: Someone among them wants to hug you.
examples.zh: 他们中有一个人想要拥抱你。

huge.definition: s. unusually great in size or amount or degree or especially extent or scope
huge.translation: a. 极大的, 巨大的, 无限的

examples.en: We arrived to find a huge meal ready for us.
examples.zh: 我们到达后发现一顿大餐已经为我们准备好了。

examples.en: They made huge, grotesque, yet beautiful poles of red cedar.
examples.zh: 他们用红雪松制作了巨大、怪诞却又美丽的木杆。

examples.en: Furthermore, I still don't think this a huge cultural difference.
examples.zh: 而且，我还是认为这准不是个巨大的文化区别。

human.definition: a. characteristic of humanity\na. relating to a person\na. having human form or attributes as opposed to those of animals or divine beings
human.translation: n. 人, 人类\na. 人类的, 似人类的, 人性的, 有同情心的

examples.en: Desire for food and sex is part of human nature.
examples.zh: 食色性也（孔子）。

examples.en: From a distance, this stone looks like a human face.
examples.zh: 从远看得话，这个石头看起来像人的脸。

examples.en: The library is the meeting place of all human dreams.
examples.zh: 图书馆是人类的所有梦想交汇的地方。

humanity.definition: n. the quality of being humane
humanity.translation: n. 人性, 人类, 博爱

examples.en: All humanity will suffer if a nuclear war breaks out.
examples.zh: 一旦爆发核战争，受苦的将会是全人类。

examples.en: Humanity is now affluent due to progression in science and technology.
examples.zh: 由于科学技术的进步，人类现在很富裕。

examples.en: Cancer is a great enemy of humanity.
examples.zh: 癌症是人类的大敌。

humble.definition:
v. cause to be unpretentious
s. low or inferior in station or quality
a. marked by meekness or modesty; not arrogant or prideful
s. used of unskilled work (especially domestic work)
humble.translation: a. 低下的, 谦逊的, 粗陋的\nvt. 使...卑下, 降低...地位, 贬抑

examples.en: Be it ever so humble, there's no place like home.
examples.zh: 金窝银窝不如自己的狗窝。

examples.en: The humble man is getting along with his neighbors.
examples.zh: 那个谦逊的男人跟邻里相处得很好。

examples.en: Ziri felt humbled by such a scenery.
examples.zh: 眼前的景色让齐里感到自身的渺小。

humid.definition: s. containing or characterized by a great deal of water vapor
humid.translation: a. 潮湿的, 湿润的, 多湿气的

examples.en: Hot and humid weather puts me in a bad mood.
examples.zh: 天气一闷热，我的心情就不好。

examples.en: It is extremely hot and humid in Bali in December.
examples.zh: 12月份巴厘岛极其炎热和潮湿。

examples.en: It is less humid today than it was yesterday.
examples.zh: 今天没有昨天潮湿。

humiliate.definition: v. cause to feel shame; hurt the pride of
humiliate.translation: vt. 使丢脸, 使蒙羞, 屈辱

examples.en: The boy was not humiliated by the laughter of his classmates.
examples.zh: 那个男孩没有因为他同学的笑而谦卑。

examples.en: I didn't want to humiliate you.
examples.zh: 我不是想要羞辱你。

examples.en: I was never so humiliated in my life.
examples.zh: 我一生中从没那么糗过。

humor.definition: n. the trait of appreciating (and being able to express) the humorous\nn. the quality of being funny\nn. (Middle Ages) one of the four fluids in the body whose balance was believed to determine your emotional and physical state
humor.translation: n. 幽默, 诙谐, 心情\nvt. 迎合, 牵就, 顺应

examples.en: It is a pity that he has no sense of humor.
examples.zh: 可惜他是一个完全没有幽默感的人。

examples.en: Our teacher has a wonderful sense of humor.
examples.zh: 我们的老师非常有幽默感。

examples.en: She looks down on me for not having a sense of humor.
examples.zh: 她很瞧不起我，认为我没有幽默细胞。

humorous.definition: a. full of or characterized by humor
humorous.translation: a. 富幽默感的, 滑稽的, 诙谐的

examples.en: "She's not only beautiful but also humorous." "Can she cook?" "Who cares?"
examples.zh: “她又有魅力又风趣！” “那她会做饭吗？” “谁在乎？”

examples.en: The writer is very humorous.
examples.zh: 作家很有幽默感。

hundred.definition: n. ten 10s\ns. being ten more than ninety
hundred.translation: n. 百, 百个东西\nnum. 百, 百个\na. 一百的, 许多的

examples.en: No man can live to be two hundred years old.
examples.zh: 没有人能够活到两百岁。

examples.en: I'll bet you a hundred dollars that Tom is gay.
examples.zh: 我和你赌一百元，汤姆是同性恋。

examples.en: I don't like books with more than five hundred pages.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢五百页以上的书。

hunger.definition: n. a physiological need for food; the consequence of food deprivation\nn. strong desire for something (not food or drink)\nv. feel the need to eat
hunger.translation: n. 饥饿, 渴望, 饥荒\nvt. 使挨饿\nvi. 挨饿, 渴望

examples.en: Many people are suffering from hunger around the world.
examples.zh: 世界上许多人在挨饿。

examples.en: Millions of people die of hunger each year.
examples.zh: 每年有几百万人死于饥饿。

examples.en: Many of the workers died of hunger.
examples.zh: 许多工人死于饥饿。

hungry.definition: a. feeling hunger; feeling a need or desire to eat food
hungry.translation: a. 饥饿的, 荒年的, 渴望的, 不毛的\n[化] 欠鞣皮

examples.en: Please give me something to eat. I am so hungry.
examples.zh: 可以给我一点吃的吗？我快饿疯了啦。

examples.en: I wasn't very hungry, so I decided to eat later.
examples.zh: 因为我不是很饿，所以我决定晚点吃。

examples.en: I'm hungry, so I'm going to get something to eat.
examples.zh: 我饿了，所以我要吃东西。

hunt.definition:
n. Englishman and Pre-Raphaelite painter (1827-1910)
n. United States architect (1827-1895)
n. British writer who defended the Romanticism of Keats and Shelley (1784-1859)
n. an association of huntsmen who hunt for sport
hunt.translation: n. 狩猎, 追捕, 搜寻, 猎区\nvt. 狩猎, 打猎, 搜索\nvi. 打猎, 猎食, 搜寻

examples.en: Have you ever seen a snow leopard hunt in the mountains?
examples.zh: 你见过雪豹在山上狩猎吗？

examples.en: The witch hunt has begun.
examples.zh: 政治迫害开始了。

examples.en: Hemingway enjoyed big game hunting in Africa.
examples.zh: 海明威喜欢在非洲的大狩猎。

hurdle.definition: n. a light movable barrier that competitors must leap over in certain races\nn. an obstacle that you are expected to overcome\nv. jump a hurdle
hurdle.translation: n. 障碍, 跳栏, 临时活动篱笆\nvt. 用篱笆围, 越过, 克服

examples.en: The biggest hurdle for pupils writing the exam was question fourteen.
The athlete caught his foot on the hurdle.
There are many hurdles to overcome when translating literary texts.

hurl.definition: n. a violent throw\nv. throw forcefully\nv. utter with force; utter vehemently
hurl.translation: n. 用力的投掷\nvt. 用力投掷, 发射, 愤慨地说出, 丢下\nvi. 猛投, 猛掷

examples.en: I hoped you could hurl some lumens into the gloom.
My first reaction was to hurl myself at him.
If you hurl a handful of stones, at least one will hit.

hurricane.definition: n. a severe tropical cyclone usually with heavy rains and winds moving a 73-136 knots (12 on the Beaufort scale)
hurricane.translation: n. 飓风, 暴风, 暴风雨

examples.en: After the hurricane, their house was a wreck.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，他们的房子成了废墟。

hurt.definition:
v. give trouble or pain to
v. cause damage or affect negatively
v. hurt the feelings of
v. feel physical pain
hurt.translation: n. 伤害, 创伤, 损害\nv. 伤害, (使)伤心, 危害, 刺痛

examples.en: She hurt her foot when she fell off her bicycle.
examples.zh: 她在从自行车上摔下来时伤到了脚。

examples.en: Roger slipped on the ice and hurt his leg.
examples.zh: 罗杰在冰上滑倒了，弄伤了腿。

examples.en: A hundred people were hurt in a train wreck.
examples.zh: 一百多个人在一个火车事故中受了伤。

husband.definition: n. a married man; a woman's partner in marriage
husband.translation: n. 丈夫, 管理人, 节俭的人\nvt. 节俭, 使成丈夫, 持有

examples.en: Mary claimed the bag was a gift from her husband.
examples.zh: 玛莉表示，包包是丈夫送的礼物。

examples.en: The widow mourned for her husband for a long time.
examples.zh: 寡妇为她的丈夫哀悼了很久。

examples.en: They say she and her husband can't agree on anything.
examples.zh: 他们说她和她的丈夫不可能对任何事达成协议。

hustle.definition:
v. cause to move furtively and hurriedly
v. sell something to or obtain something from by energetic and especially underhanded activity
v. get by trying hard
v. pressure or urge someone into an action
hustle.translation: n. 心碌, 挤, 推, 拥挤喧嚷\nvt. 催促, 乱挤活动, 硬逼, 强夺\nvi. 赶紧, 硬挤过去

examples.en: Come on, we need to hustle.
examples.zh: 快点，我们要加把劲了。

hut.translation: n. 小屋, 茅舍, 临时军营\nv. (使)住在茅舍

examples.en: This hut is a very special place.
examples.zh: 这个窝棚是个很特别的地方。

hybrid.definition: n. a composite of mixed origin\nn. (genetics) an organism that is the offspring of genetically dissimilar parents or stock; especially offspring produced by breeding plants or animals of different varieties or breeds or species\ns. produced by crossbreeding
hybrid.translation: n. 混血儿, 杂种, 混合物\na. 混合的, 杂种的, 混合语的\n[计] NetWare的主机实用程序, 双重用户建立程序

examples.en: I am not related in any way to Hybrid Turkeys­.
"Is it an indica or a sativa?" "It's a hybrid."
Flavio created a hybrid between a termite and a bee.

hydrogen.definition: n. a nonmetallic univalent element that is normally a colorless and odorless highly flammable diatomic gas; the simplest and lightest and most abundant element in the universe

examples.en: A water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
examples.zh: 一个水分子是由两个氢原子和一个氧原子组成的。

examples.en: Water is made up of oxygen and hydrogen.
examples.zh: 氧和氢组成了水。

examples.en: The chemical symbol "H" stands for hydrogen.
examples.zh: 化学符号“H”表示氢。

hygiene.definition: n. a condition promoting sanitary practices\nn. the science concerned with the prevention of illness and maintenance of health
hygiene.translation: n. 卫生保健, 卫生学, 保健法\n[医] 卫生, 卫生学

examples.en: Brush your teeth twice a day for good oral hygiene.
I prefer not to neglect the rules of personal hygiene.
She studies hygiene as part of her domestic science course.

hymn.definition: n. a song of praise (to God or to a saint or to a nation)\nv. sing a hymn\nv. praise by singing a hymn
hymn.translation: n. 赞美诗, 圣歌\nv. 唱赞美歌

examples.en: The National Anthem of Greece is the "Hymn to Liberty".
Tom will be singing his favorite hymn at today's church service.
Sami was singing his favorite hymn, Amazing Grace.

hype.definition: v. publicize in an exaggerated and often misleading manner
hype.translation: n. 大肆宣传；皮下注射

examples.en: Voice assistants did not live up to the hype.
Few fields have been more filled with hype than artificial intelligence.
Is this what all the hype was about?

hypothesis.definition: n. a proposal intended to explain certain facts or observations\nn. a tentative insight into the natural world; a concept that is not yet verified but that if true would explain certain facts or phenomena

examples.en: We can now say definitely that this hypothesis holds water.
examples.zh: 我们现在能肯定地说，这个假设是成立的。

examples.en: The idea of perpetual motion is an absurd hypothesis.
examples.zh: 永动机这个概念是个荒唐的假说。

examples.en: We have sufficient evidence to prove this hypothesis.
examples.zh: 我们有充分的理由论证这个假设。

hysteria.definition: n. excessive or uncontrollable fear\nn. neurotic disorder characterized by violent emotional outbreaks and disturbances of sensory and motor functions
hysteria.translation: n. 歇斯底里症, 不正常的兴奋, 癔病\n[医] 癔病, 歇斯底里

examples.en: Tom doesn't know the difference between passion and hysteria.
The pandemics turned into a hysteria.
Hysteria is at fever pitch.

habitual.definition: s commonly used or practiced; usual
habitual.translation: a. 习惯的, 惯常的, 平常的\n[法] 习惯的, 以习惯为常业的, 惯常的

examples.en: Grandfather sat in his habitual place near the fire.
He was fired for his habitual lateness.
They went for their habitual evening walk.

hallmark.definition: n. a distinctive characteristic or attribute
hallmark.translation: n. 纯度检验证明, 品质证明\nvt. 加盖纯度检验证明

examples.en: The hallmark of a sociopath is a lack of empathy.
A certain hallmark of wisdom is the cheerful benevolence it confers.
His easy charm and wit were the hallmarks of William's charisma.

hallway.definition: n. an interior passage or corridor onto which rooms open

examples.en: The hallway needs to be wide enough for a wheelchair.
examples.zh: 走廊要够轮椅宽。

examples.en: The principal severely reproved the students whenever they made a mess in the hallway.
examples.zh: 每次学生把走廊弄得一团糟的时候，校长都会严厉地训斥他们。

hamlet.definition: n. a community of people smaller than a village\nn. the hero of William Shakespeare's tragedy who hoped to avenge the murder of his father

examples.en: I will have read Hamlet three times if I read it again.
examples.zh: 我再看一次《王子复仇记》，加起来一共就看过三次了。

examples.en: It is said that "Hamlet" is the most interesting play ever written.
examples.zh: 据说《哈姆雷特》是写出来的最有意思的剧本。

examples.en: He played the part of Hamlet.
examples.zh: 他扮演哈姆雷特的角色。

handout.definition: n. an announcement distributed to members of the press in order to supplement or replace an oral presentation\nn. giving money or food or clothing to a needy person
handout.translation: n. 施舍物, 救济品, 分发的印刷品资料, 广告物品

examples.en: The poor man was looking for a handout.
I couldn't print the handouts because the printer wasn't working.
We take pride in being self-sufficient. We don't want a permanent handout.

haphazard.definition: s. dependent upon or characterized by chance\ns. marked by great carelessness\nr. without care; in a slapdash manner
haphazard.translation: n. 偶然性, 偶然事件\na. 无计划的, 偶然的, 随便的\nadv. 偶然地

examples.en: The march toward progress is really more of a haphazard stagger.
Haphazard eating habits caused the castaway's food supply to be quickly depleted.
She made a haphazard attempt at cleaning.

harassment.definition: n. a feeling of intense annoyance caused by being tormented\nn. the act of tormenting by continued persistent attacks and criticism
harassment.translation: n. 困扰, 烦扰, 烦恼\n[法] 折磨, 骚扰, 侵扰

examples.en: Oleg has to deal with being the subject of harassment.
Sexual harassment can be a serious problem in the workplace.
Mary was subjected to persistent bullying and harassment at work.

hardy.definition:
n. United States slapstick comedian who played the pompous and overbearing member of the Laurel and Hardy duo who made many films (1892-1957)
n. English novelist and poet (1840-1928)
s. having rugged physical strength; inured to fatigue or hardships
s. able to survive under unfavorable weather conditions
hardy.translation: a. 难的, 艰苦的, 坚硬的, 勇敢的\nadv. 努力地, 辛苦地, 坚硬地

examples.en: He read another book by Thomas Hardy.
Karl mentioned the English author Thomas Hardy.
The English are a hardy people.

havoc.translation: n. 大破坏, 蹂躏\nvt. 严重破坏

examples.en: It's astonishing how much havoc a single person can wreak.
The Golden Horde wreaked havoc and death all around Eurasia.
In the 1990's, Islamist terrorist groups wreaked havoc in Algeria.

hectic.definition: s marked by intense agitation or emotion
hectic.translation: a. 脸上发红, 发热的, 潮热的, 肺病的\nn. 脸红, 潮热病人

examples.en: The daily life can be busy, hectic and sometimes overwhelming.
I had a hectic workday with back-to-back meetings and deadlines.
I don't work now and I lead a less hectic life.

helm.definition: n. steering mechanism for a vessel; a mechanical device by which a vessel is steered\nn. a position of leadership\nv. be at or take the helm of
helm.translation: n. 舵, 驾驶盘, 枢机, 头盔\nvt. 给...掌舵, 指挥, 给...戴头盔

examples.en: Bad people are at the helm of the nation.
The captain stood abaft the helm, steering the ship.
This great helm weighs quite a bit.

herald.definition: n. (formal) a person who announces important news
herald.translation: n. 使者, 传令官, 先驱\nvt. 预报, 宣布, 传达, 欢呼

examples.en: It was the lark, the herald of the morn, no nightingale.
The cockerel, herald of the morning, wakes those of us sleeping.
Our victory must herald a new and better future for our children.

herbal.definition: a. of or relating to herbs
herbal.translation: a. 草药的\n[医] 本草书

examples.en: I returned to bed with herbal tea and a piece of cake.
examples.zh: 我回到床上，喝了杯花草茶，吃了一块蛋糕。

hereditary.definition: s occurring among members of a family usually by heredity\ns inherited or inheritable by established rules (usually legal rules) of descent
hereditary.translation: a. 世袭的, 遗传的\n[医] 遗传的

examples.en: The disease we are talking about is hereditary.
Hereditary Prince Alois is the regent of Liechtenstein.
Cousin marriage increases the risk of hereditary disease.

hibernate.definition: v. sleep during winter\nv. be in an inactive or dormant state
hibernate.translation: vi. 过冬, 冬眠, 避寒

examples.en: Many European birds hibernate in the north of Africa.
How many animals can you name that hibernate?
Crocodiles do not hibernate but estivate within caves during the dry season.

hoarse.definition: s deep and harsh sounding as if from shouting or illness or emotion
hoarse.translation: a. 沙哑的, 嘶哑的\n[医] 声嘶的

examples.en: They were all hoarse from shouting.
examples.zh: 他们全都叫到沙哑了。

hoax.definition: v. subject to a playful hoax or joke
hoax.translation: vt. 欺骗, 哄骗, 愚弄\nn. 愚弄人, 恶作剧

examples.en: My grandpa believes that the moon landing was a hoax.
examples.zh: 我的祖父相信登月是一个骗局。

homage.translation: n. 尊崇, 尊敬, 效忠

examples.en: The American director made an homage to spaghetti western films.
I meant to pay homage to her with that.
I meant to pay homage to him with that.

homeland.definition: n the country where you were born

examples.en: I suddenly feel nostalgic for my homeland.
examples.zh: 我突然很想念我的故乡。

examples.en: The security level, as established by the Department of Homeland Security, is orange.
examples.zh: 根据国土安全部的规定，目前的安全水准是橙色等级。

examples.en: They fought for their homeland.
examples.zh: 他们为祖国而战斗。

homicide.definition: n. the killing of a human being by another human being
homicide.translation: n. 杀人, 杀人者\n[医] 杀人, 杀人者

examples.en: Make no mistake, we're looking at a homicide case.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，我们正在调查一桩命案。

horde.definition: n. a vast multitude\nn. a nomadic community
horde.translation: n. (一)群, 游牧部落, 移动群\nvi. 成群结队

examples.en: Tom defected to the monster horde after befriending an orc.
The Golden Horde wreaked havoc and death all around Eurasia.
Tom was surrounded by a horde of screaming fangirls.

hospitable.definition: a. favorable to life and growth\na. disposed to treat guests and strangers with cordiality and generosity\ns. having an open mind
hospitable.translation: a. 好客的, 招待周到的

examples.en: The Algerians are a hospitable people.
examples.zh: 阿尔及利亚人是好客的族群。

hostility.definition: n. a hostile (very unfriendly) disposition\nn. a state of deep-seated ill-will\nn. the feeling of a hostile person
hostility.translation: n. 敌意, 敌对, 反对

examples.en: Analysts sense a growing hostility between the two countries.
I have no personal hostility to the system.
Hostilities between Algeria and Morocco have always been kept low.

humanitarian.definition: n. someone devoted to the promotion of human welfare and to social reforms\na. of or relating to or characteristic of humanitarianism
humanitarian.translation: n. 人道主义者, 博爱者, 基督凡人论者\na. 人道主义的, 博爱的, 凡人论的

examples.en: The phrase "humanitarian bombing" is an oxymoron.
examples.zh: 「人道主义轰炸」一词是自相矛盾的。

humility.definition: n. a disposition to be humble; a lack of false pride\nn. a humble feeling
humility.translation: n. 谦逊, 谦虚, 谦卑

examples.en: Humility often achieves more than pride.
examples.zh: 满招损, 谦受益。

examples.en: Too much humility is pride.
examples.zh: 过度的谦逊就是骄傲。

examples.en: Only with wisdom can one distinguish between good and evil; only with humility can one build a happy life.
examples.zh: 有智慧才能分辨善恶邪正；有谦虚才能建立美满人生。

hydraulic.definition: a. moved or operated or effected by liquid (water or oil)\na. of or relating to the study of hydraulics
hydraulic.translation: a. 与水有关的, 水力的, 水压的\n[电] 水力的

examples.en: Hydraulic fracturing makes use of high-pressure water to create cracks in hydrocarbon-bearing shale.
The hydraulic cylinder was the main problem and was changed to a new one.

hypocrite.definition: n. a person who professes beliefs and opinions that he or she does not hold in order to conceal his or her real feelings or motives
hypocrite.translation: n. 伪君子, 伪善者

examples.en: He went as far as to call you a hypocrite.
Frankly speaking, he is more of a hypocrite than a patriot.
I don't know what to say without sounding like a hypocrite.

humidity.translation: n. 湿气, 潮湿, 湿度\n[计] 湿度

examples.en: Humidity doesn't seem to matter much to the COVID virus.
Please avoid storing in areas with high temperature and humidity.
Greenhouse cultivation allows for better control of temperature and humidity.

hysterical.definition: s. marked by excessive or uncontrollable emotion
hysterical.translation: a. 歇斯底里的, 异常兴奋的\n[医] 癔病的, 歇斯底里的

examples.en: Is it true that she diagnosed you with hysterical neurosis?
