In the case of Mary, an hysterical neurosis was considered.
Stefan was hysterical in reaction to what Isabella told him.

hazelnut.definition: n. any of several shrubs or small trees of the genus Corylus bearing edible nuts enclosed in a leafy husk\nn. nut of any of several trees of the genus Corylus

examples.en: The coffee I drank had hazelnut cream on top.
Tom named his squirrel Hazelnut, because it likes hazelnuts.
The squirrel closed its eyes and began to count hazelnuts.

hamster.definition: n. short-tailed Old World burrowing rodent with large cheek pouches

examples.en: I have a new hamster and I've named him Dan.
She killed a hamster thinking that it was a mouse.
Sometimes, I feel like a hamster racing on a wheel.

hedgehog.definition: n. small nocturnal Old World mammal covered with both hair and protective spines
hedgehog.translation: n. 豪猪, 刺猬, 难交朋友的人, 防卫森严的阵地

examples.en: She says that she's never seen hedgehogs with ears.
examples.zh: 她说她从未见过有耳朵的刺猬。

heron.definition: n. grey or white wading bird with long neck and long legs and (usually) long bill

examples.en: Is that a stork or a heron?
examples.zh: 那是一只鹳还是一只苍鹭？

examples.en: The heron is a wading bird.
examples.zh: 苍鹭是一种涉禽。

examples.en: Lots of herons live in the marsh.
examples.zh: 许多苍鹭在沼泽地中生活。

hippopotamus.definition: n. massive thick-skinned herbivorous animal living in or around rivers of tropical Africa

examples.en: The hippopotamus was far too heavy for him to lift.
The Council slaves whipped him with their hippopotamus hide whips.
The hippopotamus is the closest relative of the whale.

harmonica.definition: n. a small rectangular free-reed instrument having a row of free reeds set back in air holes and played by blowing into the desired hole
harmonica.translation: n. 口琴, 玻璃钟琴\n[医] 氢气发音管

examples.en: One of the reeds of my harmonica has gone flat.
I always have at least one harmonica in my car.
Tom sat on the garbage can and played his harmonica.

harp.definition:
n. a chordophone that has a triangular frame consisting of a sounding board and a pillar and a curved neck; the strings stretched between the neck and the soundbox are plucked with the fingers
n. a pair of curved vertical supports for a lampshade
v. come back to
v. play the harp
harp.translation: n. 竖琴\nvi. 弹奏竖琴, 不停地说

examples.en: A young girl draped in white was playing the harp.
A young woman was playing harp near the open window.
The violin, the piano, and the harp are musical instruments.

heaven.definition: n. the abode of God and the angels
heaven.translation: n. 天堂, 上帝, 天空

examples.en: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
examples.zh: 起初，神创造了天地。

examples.en: Throughout Heaven and Earth, I alone am the honored one.
examples.zh: 天上天下，唯我独尊。

examples.en: Guilin's sceneries are the most beautiful ones under the heaven.
examples.zh: 桂林山水甲天下。

hormone.definition: n. the secretion of an endocrine gland that is transmitted by the blood to the tissue on which it has a specific effect
hormone.translation: n. 荷尔蒙\n[化] 激素(旧称荷尔蒙)

examples.en: Do transgender people need to continuously use hormones to maintain their sexual characteristics?
examples.zh: 变性者需要不断服用激素来维持性别特征吗？

handicapped.definition:
n people collectively who are crippled or otherwise physically handicapped
v injure permanently
v attempt to forecast the winner (especially in a horse race) and assign odds for or against a contestant
v put at a disadvantage
s incapable of functioning as a consequence of injury or illness
handicapped.translation: a. 残疾的\n[法] 有生理缺陷的, 残废的

examples.en: Tom is handicapped.
examples.zh: 汤姆有残疾。

hasten.definition:
v act or move at high speed
v move fast
v speed up the progress of; facilitate
v cause to occur rapidly
hasten.translation: vt. 催促, 加紧\nvi. 赶快, 急忙

examples.en: Historians say the Black Death hastened the end of feudalism.
I must hasten to add that I do not mean to blame him.
I didn't hasten to the village.

heartfelt.translation: a. 衷心的, 真心真意的

examples.en: The boy wrote a heartfelt letter to his best friend.
This book is a heartfelt tribute to love and friendship.
I'd like to give you all my heartfelt thanks for this.

hearty.definition:
s. showing warm and heartfelt friendliness
s. providing abundant nourishment
s. endowed with or exhibiting great bodily or mental health
s. consuming abundantly and with gusto
hearty.translation: a. 诚恳的, 健壮的, 热烈的, 丰盛的

examples.en: They were given a hearty welcome.
examples.zh: 他们受到了热情的欢迎。

examples.en: He laughed a hearty laugh.
examples.zh: 他从心底笑了出来。

examples.en: On behalf of the company, I would like to express our hearty thanks to you all.
examples.zh: 在此仅代表本公司向各位致上衷心的谢意。

heated.definition: s. made warm or hot (`het' is a dialectal variant of `heated')\ns. marked by emotional heat; vehement
heated.translation: a. 热的, 激昂的, 兴奋的

examples.en: I tried very hard to put an end to their heated argument.
examples.zh: 我努力地平息他们不断加温的争执。

examples.en: No matter how cold it is outside, the rooms are comfortably heated.
examples.zh: 无论外面多么寒冷，房间始终既舒适又温暖。

examples.en: Potassium, heated with a Bunsen burner, gives the flame a lilac color.
examples.zh: 用本生灯加热钾，火焰就会呈现淡紫色。

heave.definition:
n. an upward movement (especially a rhythmical rising and falling)
n. (geology) a horizontal dislocation
n. the act of lifting something with great effort
n. an involuntary spasm of ineffectual vomiting
heave.translation: n. 举, 抛, 起伏, 鼓起\nvt. 用力举起, 使举起, 使鼓起\nvi. 抛出, 起伏, 喘息, 凸起

examples.en: I heaved myself up.
examples.zh: 我把我自己用力拉起来。

heiress.translation: n. 嗣女, 女继承人\n[法] 女继承人

examples.en: Daniel made Amanda the sole heiress to his fortune.
Mary is the heiress to a large fortune.
She's the heiress to a great fortune.

henceforth.definition: r. from this time forth; from now on
henceforth.translation: adv. 自此以后, 今后

examples.en: This squirrel shall be henceforth known as "The Cute One."
Those like me and I won't repeat it henceforth.
Due to a technical malfunction, this train's service will be henceforth discontinued.
We, ACME Ltd., hereby announce that we will resist with all our strength this hostile takeover.
examples.zh: 我们ACME有限公司，特此宣布，我们将尽我们的力量抵制这种恶意收购。

heroine.definition: n. the main good female character in a work of fiction\nn. a woman possessing heroic qualities or a woman who has performed heroic deeds
heroine.translation: n. 巾帼英雄, 烈妇, 女主角\n[化] 海洛因; 二醋吗啡; 二乙酰吗啡

examples.en: The heroine of this story is a little girl.
examples.zh: 这个故事的女主角是一个小女孩。

hesitant.definition: s. lacking decisiveness of character; unable to act or decide quickly or firmly
hesitant.translation: a. 迟疑的, 踌躇的, 犹豫不定的

examples.en: Tom is hesitant to visit Mary in the hospital.
examples.zh: 对于是否要去医院探望Mary,Tom有点犹豫不决。

examples.en: Why did he remain hesitant?
examples.zh: 他为什么仍然犹豫不决？

hijack.definition: n. seizure of a vehicle in transit either to rob it or divert it to an alternate destination\nv. seize control of
hijack.translation: vt. 抢劫, 劫持, 敲诈\n[法] 挡路抢劫, 抢劫, 绑架

examples.en: If someone doesn't hijack something, it's not a good movie.
Investigators foiled a plot to hijack an airplane.
You know that I now have made hijacking my specialty.

hindrance.definition: n. something immaterial that interferes with or delays action or progress\nn. any obstruction that impedes or is burdensome\nn. the act of hindering or obstructing or impeding
hindrance.translation: n. 妨害, 障碍, 阻碍物

examples.en: Please, I'm asking you. Don't be a hindrance right now.
Some consider linguistic diversity a hindrance; I consider it precious.
Those new rules were more of a hindrance than a help.

hinge.definition: n. a joint that holds two parts together so that one can swing relative to the other\nn. a circumstance upon which subsequent events depend\nv. attach with a hinge
hinge.translation: n. 铰链, 关键, 枢纽\nvt. 装铰链\nvi. 靠铰链移动, 依...而转移

examples.en: It will hinge on whether or not she gets the promotion.
The hinges are really squeaky. Could you oil them please?
One of the hinges on that door is broken.

hitherto.definition: r used in negative statement to describe a situation that has existed up to this point or up to the present time

examples.en: Karl Marx says, "The history of all hitherto existing societies is the history of class struggles."
examples.zh: 卡尔·马克思说：“ 到目前为止的一切社会的历史都是阶级斗争的历史。”

hive.definition:
n. a teeming multitude
v. store, like bees
v. move together in a hive or as if in a hive
v. gather into a hive
hive.translation:
n. 蜂房, 闹区, 蜜蜂群
vi. 进入蜂房, 储藏蜜于蜂房, 如蜂般群居
vt. 使进蜂房, 储备
[计] 蜂巢

examples.en: He was stung by bees when he approached their hive.
This hive is the home of my bee Zosia.
There can be only one queen in the hive.

homely.definition: s. lacking in physical beauty or proportion\ns. plain and unpretentious\ns. without artificial refinement or elegance
homely.translation: a. 家常的, 平凡的, 朴实无华的

examples.en: There's a homely atmosphere in this hotel.
Tom is a very homely person.
The girl was not downright homely.

honorary.definition: s. given as an honor without the normal duties
honorary.translation: a. 荣誉的, 无报酬的, 道义上的\n[法] 名誉的, 荣誉的

examples.en: Ziri got an honorary award that very few students get.
This is the list of decorations, awards, and honorary titles.
He became an honorary citizen of our city.

hospitalize.translation: vt. 送...进医院治疗\n[医] 入院

examples.en: Do I have to be hospitalized?
examples.zh: 我必须住院吗?

examples.en: Tom is still hospitalized.
examples.zh: 汤姆还在住院。

hostess.definition: n. a woman host\nn. a woman innkeeper
hostess.translation: n. 女主人, 女房东, 女老板

examples.en: He married an air hostess.
examples.zh: 他娶了一个空姐。

hound.definition: n. any of several breeds of dog used for hunting typically having large drooping ears\nv. pursue or chase relentlessly
hound.translation: n. 猎犬\nvt. 带猎犬狩猎, 追捕, 激励, 使追逐

examples.en: What beast dost thou think thou art? Art thou a hound or a rat?
examples.zh: 你认为你是什么野兽？猎犬还是老鼠？

humane.definition: a. marked or motivated by concern with the alleviation of suffering\ns. showing evidence of moral and intellectual advancement
humane.translation: a. 有人情的, 人道的, 仁慈的

examples.en: His way of looking after the animals is very humane.
We're taking the kittens to the humane society tomorrow afternoon.
Solidarity is the driving motor of an intact and humane community.

humbly.translation: adv. 谦逊地, 卑贱地, 低声下气地

examples.en: I humbly apologize to each and everyone of you.
"Itadakimasu" is a Japanese phrase that literally means "I humbly receive."
To be continued next time, and thus I most humbly request your attendance then.

hygienic.definition: s. tending to promote or preserve health
hygienic.translation: a. 卫生学的, 卫生的, 促进健康的, 清洁的\n[医] 卫生的

examples.en: It's not very hygienic to use your hands.
Never leave the toilet unflushed, it's not hygienic.
Keep your tortoise's environment clean and hygienic.

hyphen.definition: n. a punctuation mark (-) used between parts of a compound word or between the syllables of a word when the word is divided at the end of a line of text
hyphen.translation: n. 连字符\nvt. 用连字符连接

examples.en: These days, "under-age" is usually spelled "underage", without the hyphen.
You can spell it with or without a hyphen.
What's the difference between a hyphen and a dash?

hypocrisy.definition: n. an expression of agreement that is not supported by real conviction\nn. insincerity by virtue of pretending to have qualities or beliefs that you do not really have
hypocrisy.translation: n. 伪善\n[法] 伪善, 虚伪

examples.en: This is pure hypocrisy!
examples.zh: 这真是彻底的虚伪！

hypothetical.definition: n. a hypothetical possibility, circumstance, statement, proposal, situation, etc.
hypothetical.translation: a. 假设的, 有待证实的, 假定的, 有前提的\n[计] 理想的

examples.en: When will the most probable hypothetical accident occur?
examples.zh: 最大可能假想事故什么时候会发生？

hacker.definition: n. someone who plays golf poorly\nn. a programmer who breaks into computer systems in order to steal or change or destroy information as a form of cyber-terrorism\nn. a programmer for whom computing is its own reward; may enjoy the challenge of breaking into other computers but does no harm
hacker.translation: [计] 计算机窃贼, 计算机新技术挑战者, 黑客

examples.en: Many people are unable to comprehend the actions of hackers.
examples.zh: 很多人无法理解黑客们的行为。

examples.en: Hackers find new ways of infiltrating private or public networks.
examples.zh: 骇客们找到渗透私人或公共网络的新方法。

examples.en: Hackers are adept at getting around computer security measures.
examples.zh: 黑客很会利用电脑安全措拖的漏洞。

handwriting.definition: n. something written by hand\nn. the activity of writing by hand

examples.en: There was a note on my desk in Tom's handwriting.
examples.zh: 我的桌上有一张便条，上面的字是汤姆的。

examples.en: He can't have written this; it's not his handwriting.
examples.zh: 这不是他写的，他的字迹不是这样的。

examples.en: Do you know whose handwriting this is?
examples.zh: 你知道这是谁的字吗？

harbour.definition:
n a sheltered port where ships can take on or discharge cargo
n a place of refuge and comfort and security
v secretly shelter (as of fugitives or criminals)
v keep in one's possession; of animals
v hold back a thought or feeling about
v maintain (a theory, thoughts, or feelings)
harbour.translation: n. 港, 避难所\nv. 庇护, 藏匿, (使)入港停泊

examples.en: The lost fishing boat made a safe return to harbour.
examples.zh: 迷路的渔船安全地返回了港口。

hay.definition: n. grass mowed and cured for use as fodder\nv. convert (plant material) into hay
hay.translation: n. 干草\nvt. 制干草, 供给干草\nvi. 晒干草

examples.en: We still have to turn the hay and chop wood.
I give the cows hay, and midday's work is over.
A lot of people are dealing with hay fever now.

headache.definition: n. pain in the head caused by dilation of cerebral arteries or muscle contractions or a reaction to drugs
headache.translation: n. 头痛, 令人头痛之事\n[医] 头痛

examples.en: He made me so angry that I got a headache.
examples.zh: 他让我气得头疼了。

examples.en: Pushing customers to complete a task can be a headache.
examples.zh: 催促客户去完成一件任务是很让人头疼的事。

examples.en: Correct, one has a stomachache, the other has a headache.
examples.zh: 对，一个人肚子疼，另一个人头疼。

high-tech.definition: a. resembling or making use of highly advanced technology or devices

examples.en: Japan is a leader in the world's high-tech industry.
examples.zh: 日本是世界高科技产业的领头人。

examples.en: Japan is the leader of the world's high-tech industry.
examples.zh: 日本是世界高科技产业的领头人。

examples.en: I went to the Hsinchu Science Park during summer vacation and saw many high-tech companies.
examples.zh: 我暑假去了新竹科技园区，见识了许多高科技公司。

homestay.translation: n. （在国外的访问者）在当地居民家居住的时期

examples.en: My homestay parents tried to speak to me in French.
In order to qualify for the homestay you must have an interview with the sponsors.
One of the "homestay" Japanese students in my Lulu Island home liked to play ice hockey.

housewife.definition: n. a wife who manages a household while her husband earns the family income
housewife.translation: n. 主妇, 家庭妇女

examples.en: A lot of housewives complain about the high prices of goods.
examples.zh: 许多家庭主妇抱怨物价非常高。

examples.en: These housewives are desperate.
examples.zh: 这些家庭主妇过得很绝望。

humanist.definition: n. a classical scholar or student of the liberal arts\nn. an advocate of the principles of humanism; someone concerned with the interests and welfare of humans\na. of or pertaining to a philosophy asserting human dignity and man's capacity for fulfillment through reason and scientific method and often rejecting religion
humanist.translation: n. 人道主义者, 人文学者

examples.en: Kabylia is a humanist and democratic project.
Ziri was a great humanist.

humour.definition:
n a characteristic (habitual or relatively temporary) state of feeling
n a message whose ingenuity or verbal skill or incongruity has the power to evoke laughter
n (Middle Ages) one of the four fluids in the body whose balance was believed to determine your emotional and physical state
n the liquid parts of the body
n the quality of being funny
n the trait of appreciating (and being able to express) the humorous
v put into a good mood
humour.translation: n. 幽默, 诙谐, 情绪, 体液\nvt. 使满足, 迁就

examples.en: Tom's main problem is he has no sense of humour.
examples.zh: 汤姆的主要问题是他一点幽默感都没有

examples.en: I like people with a sense of humour.
examples.zh: 我喜欢有幽默感的人。

examples.en: He has a great sense of humour.
examples.zh: 他有很好的幽默感。

haircut.definition: n. the style in which hair has been cut\nn. the act of cutting the hair

examples.en: I want to go and get a haircut.
examples.zh: 我要去剪头发了。

examples.en: He gets a haircut three times a month.
examples.zh: 他一个月剪三次头发。

examples.en: I could not help laughing at his haircut.
examples.zh: 我忍不住取笑他的发型。

halve.definition: v. divide by two; divide into halves
halve.translation: vt. 二等分, 对半分享, 把...减半

examples.en: Joy shared is joy doubled; suffering shared is suffering halved.
He did not want to halve it.
Happiness shared returns many-fold, sadness shared comes back halved.

ham.definition:
n. meat cut from the thigh of a hog (usually smoked)
n. (Old Testament) son of Noah
n. a licensed amateur radio operator
n. an unskilled actor who overacts
ham.translation: n. 火腿, 后腿, 笨拙演员\na. 过火的, 做作的\nv. 演得过火

examples.en: I think you should eat a ham sandwich.
examples.zh: 我认为你该吃火腿三明治。

examples.en: Carrefour's Ham offcuts are not expensive at all, but are nonetheless delicious.
examples.zh: 家乐福的火腿剩料一点都不贵，然而却很好吃。

examples.en: Tom probably ate a ham sandwich.
examples.zh: 汤姆可能吃了一个火腿三明治。

hamburger.definition: n. a sandwich consisting of a fried cake of minced beef served on a bun, often with other ingredients
hamburger.translation: n. 汉堡(德国港口), 肉饼, 汉堡包, 纯精牛肉, 汉堡牛排

examples.en: A hamburger and a cold drink cost 7 liras.
examples.zh: 汉堡和冷饮要七里拉。

examples.en: Can I have two hamburgers and a coke, please?
examples.zh: 可以给我来两个汉堡和一杯可乐吗？谢谢。

examples.en: Please give me a hamburger.
examples.zh: 请给我一个汉堡。

hare.definition: n. swift timid long-eared mammal larger than a rabbit having a divided upper lip and long hind legs; young born furred and with open eyes\nv. run quickly, like a hare

examples.en: If you run after two hares, you will catch neither.
examples.zh: 脚踏两条船，必定落空。

examples.en: It is not easy to catch a hare with your bare hands.
examples.zh: 空手赤拳抓野兔并不容易。

examples.en: The hare was overtaken by the tortoise.
examples.zh: 野兔被乌龟抛了在后头。

hassle.translation: n. 激烈而持久的争论\nvi. 争论\nvt. 与...争辩, 使烦恼

examples.en: It's become a hassle to keep on dyeing my hair.
examples.zh: 一直染发太麻烦了。

hateful.definition: a. evoking or deserving hatred\ns. characterized by malice
hateful.translation: a. 憎恨的, 可恨的, 可恶的

examples.en: I can't believe Tom said such hateful things about Mary.
Denouncing hateful speech can help maintain a safe environment online.
What is hateful to you, do not do to your fellow.

haughty.definition: s having or showing arrogant superiority to and disdain of those one views as unworthy
haughty.translation: a. 傲慢的, 骄傲的, 崇高的

examples.en: Cinderella's stepsisters were just as haughty as was her stepmother.
She gave me a haughty look and walked away.
Poor piteous reasoning. Weak beyond contempt your haughty minds!

hawk.definition: n. diurnal bird of prey typically having short rounded wings and a long tail\nn. an advocate of an aggressive policy on foreign relations\nv. hunt with hawks
hawk.translation: n. 鹰, 掠夺者, 鹰派成员\nvi. 放鹰行猎, 像鹰一般地袭击, 清嗓, 咳嗽\nvt. 捕捉, 咳出, 兜售, 叫卖, 散播

examples.en: The bird was half the size of a hawk.
examples.zh: 那只鸟的体积有半只老鹰那么大。

examples.en: The hawk caught a mouse.
examples.zh: 这只鹰抓到一只老鼠。

headlong.definition: r. with the head foremost\nr. at breakneck speed\nr. in a hasty and foolhardy manner
headlong.translation: a. 头向前的, 仓猝而用力的, 轻率的\nadv. 头向前地, 猛然地, 用力地

examples.en: He throws himself headlong into everything he undertakes.
The car went out of control and pitched headlong into the river.
Mugabe's regime did not so much slide as plunge headlong into kleptocracy.

headmaster.definition: n. presiding officer of a school

examples.en: He has just become headmaster.
examples.zh: 他刚成为一名校长。

hearth.definition: n. home symbolized as a part of the fireplace\nn. an area near a fireplace (usually paved and extending out into a room)
hearth.translation: n. 炉床, 灶台, 炉边\n[化] 锻造炉; 敞炉; 炉缸; 炉床; 火床; 炉膛

examples.en: In Victorian age, women were considered "Angels of the hearth".
Vesta was the goddess of the hearth and home.
A woman is the guardian of the hearth.

heater.definition: n. device that heats water or supplies warmth to a room
heater.translation: n. 加热器, 灯丝, 加热工\n[化] 加热器

examples.en: Don't let the cops find a heater on you.
examples.zh: 不要给警察发现你身上有枪。

examples.en: The heater is aglow with a beautiful orange color.
examples.zh: 加热器发出美丽的橙色光芒。

examples.en: When the heater in the barn fails, you get milk-flavoured ice cubes.
examples.zh: 当牛舍的暖气坏了, 你就会有牛奶味的冰块。

heating.definition: n. the process of becoming warmer; a rising temperature
heating.translation: n. 加热, 供热, 暖气设备, 供暖系统, 暖气装置\na. 加热的, 供暖的

examples.en: I'm cold. Would you mind turning the heating on?
examples.zh: 我很冷。你介意把暖气打开吗？

examples.en: Heating water does not change its chemical composition.
examples.zh: 把水加热不改变它的化学成分。

examples.en: Does the heating work in the winter?
examples.zh: 冬天暖气热不热？

heavily.definition:
r. to a considerable degree
r. in a heavy-footed manner
r. with great force
r. in a manner designed for heavy duty
heavily.translation: adv. 很重地, 严重地, 难以忍受地

examples.en: It was raining heavily when I got up this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上起来的时候雨下得很大。

examples.en: I had hardly left home when it began to rain heavily.
examples.zh: 当雨开始下得很大的时候, 我几乎不能出门了。

examples.en: It has been raining heavily for three hours.
examples.zh: 下了三小时大雨。

heel.definition:
n. the bottom of a shoe or boot; the back part of a shoe or boot that touches the ground and provides elevation
n. the back part of the human foot
n. one of the crusty ends of a loaf of bread
n. the lower end of a ship's mast
heel.translation: n. 脚后跟, 踵, 后部, 倾侧\nvt. 尾随, 装以鞋跟, 倾侧, 追赶\nvi. 紧随, 用脚后跟传球

examples.en: The heels of his socks had been worn out.
examples.zh: 他袜子的后跟破了。

examples.en: She wears high heels to make herself look taller.
examples.zh: 她穿著高跟鞋，这样显得更高一些。

examples.en: Mary was in high heels.
examples.zh: 玛莉穿著高跟鞋。

helmet.definition: n. armor plate that protects the head\nn. a protective headgear made of hard material to resist blows
helmet.translation: n. 钢盔, 盔, 防护帽\nvt. 给...戴头盔

examples.en: You have to wear a helmet to protect your head.
examples.zh: 你要戴上头盔来保护你的头部。

examples.en: It is dangerous to ride a motorbike without a helmet.
examples.zh: 开摩托车不戴头盔是很危险的。

examples.en: She felt much safer once she’d put her helmet on.
examples.zh: 她一戴上安全帽就感觉安全多了。

helpless.definition: s. lacking in or deprived of strength or power\ns. unable to function; without help\ns. unable to manage independently
helpless.translation: a. 无助的, 无能为力的, 无依无靠的

examples.en: When I was helpless, no one came to my defense.
Poor sanitation practices rendered Europe helpless against the Black Death.
Tom shot the helpless rodent with his BB gun.

hen.definition:
n. adult female chicken
n. adult female bird
n. flesh of an older chicken suitable for stewing
n. female of certain aquatic animals e.g. octopus or lobster

examples.en: That fox must have killed the hen.
examples.zh: 那只狐狸杀了一只母鸡。

examples.en: He likes me! - The cook's hen said.
examples.zh: 他喜欢我！—厨师的母鸡说。

examples.en: Our hens laid a lot of eggs yesterday.
examples.zh: 我们养的母鸡昨天生了很多蛋。

hillside.definition: n. the side or slope of a hill

examples.en: The hillside had torrential flooding from the west.
examples.zh: 山坡让滔滔的洪水往西流。

hip.definition:
n. either side of the body below the waist and above the thigh
n. the ball-and-socket joint between the head of the femur and the acetabulum
n. (architecture) the exterior angle formed by the junction of a sloping side and a sloping end of a roof
n. the fruit of a rose plant
hip.translation:
n. 臀部, 蔷薇果, 忧郁
a. 熟悉内情的
vt. 使忧郁, 给(屋顶)造屋脊
interj. 喝彩声

examples.en: He got a hip ultrasound.
examples.zh: 他做了髋部超音波检查。

hiss.definition:
n. a fricative sound (especially as an expression of disapproval)
v. make a sharp hissing sound, as if to show disapproval
v. move with a whooshing sound
v. express or utter with a hiss
hiss.translation: n. 嘘声, 嘶嘶声\nvi. 发出嘘声, 发嘶嘶声\nvt. 发嘶嘶声表示

examples.en: The hiss of rushing gas could be heard.
The cat hissed at me and arched its back.
The goose hissed and threw itself at the boy.

historian.definition: n. a person who is an authority on history and who studies it and writes about it
historian.translation: n. 历史学家, 记事者

examples.en: He works at a scientific institute where linguists, literature scholars, historians, sociologists, economists, and other scholars investigate everything that has to do with gnomes.
examples.zh: 他在一家科学机构工作，在那里有语言学家，文学学者，历史学家，社会学家，经济学家和其他学者探讨一切有关侏儒的事。

hoe.definition: n. a tool with a flat blade attached at right angles to a long handle\nv. dig with a hoe
hoe.translation: n. 锄头\nv. 用锄耕地, 锄

examples.en: Make the hoe your sword, and the sword your hoe.
examples.zh: 化锄为剑，化剑为锄。

examples.en: Be careful when working with a hoe.
examples.zh: 用锄头的时候小心一些

honey.definition: n. a sweet yellow liquid produced by bees\nv. sweeten with honey\ns. of something having the color of honey
honey.translation:
n. 蜂蜜, 甜蜜, 爱人
a. 蜂蜜似的, 甜蜜的, 甘美的
vt. 加蜜使甜, 对...说甜言蜜语
vi. 说甜言蜜语, 奉承

examples.en: Tom put a lot of honey on his toast.
examples.zh: 汤姆往他的面包片上放了许多蜂蜜。

examples.en: Honey in the mouth and poison in the heart.
examples.zh: 口中有蜜，心中有毒。

examples.en: Tom and Mary sometimes put honey in their tea.
examples.zh: 汤姆和玛丽有时会在茶里放蜂蜜。

honeymoon.definition: n. a holiday taken by a newly married couple\nn. the early (usually calm and harmonious) period of a relationship; business or political\nv. spend a holiday after one's marriage
honeymoon.translation: n. 蜜月, 蜜月假期\nvi. 渡蜜月

examples.en: A honeymoon in Canada costs a lot of money.
examples.zh: 去加拿大渡蜜月要花很多钱。

examples.en: More and more couples go on honeymoon trips abroad.
examples.zh: 越来越多的情侣出国度蜜月。

examples.en: Tom and Mary went on a two week honeymoon to Hawaii.
examples.zh: 汤姆和玛丽去夏威夷度蜜月，度了两个星期。

honour.definition:
n the state of being honored
n a tangible symbol signifying approval or distinction
n the quality of being honorable and having a good name
n a woman's virtue or chastity
v bestow honor or rewards upon
v show respect towards
v accept as pay
honour.translation: n. 荣誉, 头衔, 信用, 尊敬, 名誉, 阁下, 勋章\nvt. 尊敬, 授予荣誉, 承兑, 实践

examples.en: To work for your father was an honour for me.
Would you do me the honour of a moonlight stroll?
"God bless you!" he cried. "You have saved my honour."

honourable.definition: a worthy of being honored; entitled to honor and respect\ns adhering to ethical and moral principles
honourable.translation: a. 值得尊敬的, 荣耀的, 高贵的\n[法] 荣誉的, 正直的, 体面的

examples.en: I heard a very honourable story from the company president.
An honourable death is better than a shameful life.
You must avoid misbehaving in order to be a honourable person.

hop.definition:
n. the act of hopping; jumping upward or forward (especially on one foot)
n. twining perennials having cordate leaves and flowers arranged in conelike spikes; the dried flowers of this plant are used in brewing to add the characteristic bitter taste to beer
n. an informal dance where popular music is played
v. jump lightly
hop.translation:
n. 单脚跳, 跳跃, 舞会, 飞行
vi. 单脚跳, 跳跃
vt. 跃过, 跳上, 加蛇麻子于, 服麻醉药
[计] 跳跃式传输

examples.en: Let me know beforehand instead of catching me on the hop at the last minute.
examples.zh: 事先打个招呼，别叫我临时抓瞎。

examples.en: His wife was hopping mad.
examples.zh: 他老婆气极了。

horsepower.definition: n. a unit of power equal to 746 watts

examples.en: This car has more than a hundred horsepower.
The horsepower of a car matters not, with a donkey in control.
How much horsepower does a horse have?

hose.definition: n. man's close-fitting garment of the 16th and 17th centuries covering the legs and reaching up to the waist; worn with a doublet\nn. a flexible pipe for conveying a liquid or gas\nv. water with a hose
hose.translation: n. 水管, 橡皮软管, 长统袜\nvt. 用水管浇

examples.en: Tom drank the water as it came out the hose.
Ziri asked Rima if he could borrow her garden hose.
Tom sprinkled water on the vegetables with the garden hose.

however.definition:
r. despite anything to the contrary (usually following a concession)
r. by contrast; on the other hand; the second, however, took hours"
r. to whatever degree or extent
r. in whatever way or manner
however.translation: adv. 然而, 无论如何, 究竟怎样\nconj. 然而, 可是

examples.en: However you do it, the result will be the same.
examples.zh: 你无论用甚么方法，结果都是一样。

examples.en: However vast the darkness, we must supply our own light.
examples.zh: 不论黑暗如何辽阔，我们都必须提供自身的光明。

examples.en: Tom and Mary can do that however they like.
examples.zh: 汤姆和玛丽做事都是随自己喜欢的方式。

hull.definition:
n. dry outer covering of a fruit or seed or nut
n. persistent enlarged calyx at base of e.g. a strawberry or raspberry
n. United States naval officer who commanded the `Constitution' during the War of 1812 and won a series of brilliant victories against the British (1773-1843)
n. United States diplomat who did the groundwork for creating the United Nations (1871-1955)
hull.translation: n. 壳, 皮, 船体\nvt. 去壳

examples.en: Tom scraped the barnacles off the hull of the ship.
They scraped barnacles off the hull of the ship.
There's no sign of damage to the hull.

hum.definition:
n. a humming noise
v. sing with closed lips
v. be noisy with activity
v. sound with a monotonous hum
hum.translation:
n. 嗡嗡声, 哼声, 杂声
vi. 发低哼声
vt. 哼, 用哼声表示
interj. 哼, 嗯

examples.en: She is humming a song in four beats.
examples.zh: 她哼着四拍子的歌。

examples.en: She was humming a song in four beats.
examples.zh: 她哼着四拍子的歌。

examples.en: She hummed a song in four beats.
examples.zh: 她哼着四拍子的歌。

humiliation.definition: n. state of disgrace or loss of self-respect\nn. an instance in which you are caused to lose your prestige or self-respect\nn. depriving one of self-esteem
humiliation.translation: n. 耻辱, 丢脸, 谦卑

examples.en: How do you put up with that kind of humiliation?
Sami suffered a decade of abuse and humiliation from Layla.
Ziri was a victim of humiliation and abuse.

hurrah.translation: n. 欢呼声, 骚动, 欢乐\nv. 欢呼, 呼万岁, 以欢呼迎接\ninterj. 万岁

examples.en: Hurrah to the King of Swing!
"Hurrah! hurrah! hurrah!" cried a young boy, as he capered vigorously about, and clapped his hands.

hush.definition:
n. (poetic) tranquil silence
v. become quiet or still; fall silent
v. cause to be quiet or not talk
v. wash by removing particles
hush.translation: n. 肃静, 安静, 沉默\nvt. (使)肃静, (使)安静, (使)缄默\ninterj. 嘘, 别作声

examples.en: The victim of blackmail has been paying hush money for years, but now he realizes it is foolish, and has decided not to pay a red cent more.
examples.zh: 被害人被勒索支付封口费已经很多年, 但现在他意识到这样做是愚蠢的, 而且他已经决定再也不付一毛钱了。

hydrocarbon.definition: n. an organic compound containing only carbon and hydrogen
hydrocarbon.translation: n. 碳氢化合物\n[化] 烃; 碳氢化合物

examples.en: A hydrocarbon consists exclusively of carbon and hydrogen atoms.
Algeria needs to move away from its reliance on hydrocarbons.
Hydrocarbon exploration has ceased with declining oil prices.
